item.title: Andrew Scott's AIDS drama 'Elsinore' kicks off London Film Festival
item.description: Actor Andrew Scott says the biographical drama "Elsinore", which opened the 2026 London Film Festival on Wednesday, is an ode to living fully in the face of tragedy.
item.dc:creator: Hanna Rantala
item.content:encoded: Actor Andrew Scott says the biographical drama "Elsinore", which opened the 2026 London Film Festival on Wednesday, is an ode to living fully in the face of tragedy. Scott, a stage and screen actor of "Fleabag", "Ripley" and "All of Us Strangers" fame, both stars in and produced the movie. "Elsinore" tells the true story of Scottish actor Ian Charleson, best known for his starring role in "Chariots of Fire", and is set in late 1989. Daniel Day-Lewis has just walked off the stage in the middle of a performance of "Hamlet" and Charleson, frustrated with the film roles on offer, sees an opportunity to return to meaningful work. But as he prepares to take on the demanding titular stage role, Charleson's health begins to deteriorate after he is diagnosed with AIDS. Directed by Simon Stone and written by Stephen Beresford, "Elsinore" centres on Charleson's final months as he defies his debilitating condition and doctors' orders to put on a triumphant performance of "Hamlet". "It was a very big undertaking," Scott said on the red carpet near the National Theatre, where most of the film takes place. "I think the biggest thing for me was to understand that he was a man who had a great zest for life, and who was very funny and kind of charming and sexy and a wonderful person who was deeply loved and to remember how he lived as much as how he died." Scott's performance has won wide critical acclaim and Oscar buzz. The actor said he could feel he was making something "very special" while shooting the movie. "It's a completely wonderful part, incredible screenplay, amazing cast, and you get to do so much stuff in it. I definitely realised it was a part that doesn't come around very often." Olivia Colman portrays pioneering doctor Margaret Johnson, whose efforts to treat stigmatized patients at the height of the AIDS crisis are highlighted in the film. "She was a hero, as were all the families, nurses, other doctors and friends who refused to be poisoned by the paranoia. I want them to be remembered, too," Colman said. This year's London Film Festival runs through October 18, with the lineup featuring a host of high-profile titles including John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell-led "Wild Horse Nine", Luca Guadagnino's "Artificial" starring Andrew Garfield as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Robert Pattinson's "Primetime", classical music drama "Behemoth!" featuring Pedro Pascal and Danny Boyle's the Sun newspaper drama "Ink".

item.title: トランプ米政権、留学生の就労許可に7万ドル徴収案
item.description:
Susan Heavey
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は、米国内での就労を希望する...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トランプ米政権、留学生の就労許可に7万ドル徴収案 9:11 配信

カリフォルニア大学バークレー校。2023年6月撮影。 REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Susan Heavey

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は、米国内での就労を希望する留学生に少なくとも７万ドルの支払いを義務付ける案を示した。７日にオンラインで掲載された政府の通知で明らかになった。トランプ政権による外国人ビザ保有者への締め付け強化の一環となる。

提案によると、非移民学生ビザ「Ｆ１」の保有者は「オプショナル・プラクティカル・トレーニング（ＯＰＴ）」と呼ばれる一時的な就労許可制度の利用に際し、認定機関に７万ドルを支払い、延長する場合はさらに３万ドルを支払うことが義務付けられる。

ＤＨＳは、新規則の目的について「不正行為を防ぎ、移民制度の信頼性を高め、米国の労働者を保護する」ことだと説明した。

ＯＰＴ制度では、留学生は在学中に週２０時間まで、卒業後も一定期間、就労できる。科学、技術、工学、数学の学位取得者には追加の就労期間が認められている。現在、申請者が支払う費用は約５００ドル。

こうした制度は、専門職向け就労ビザ「Ｈ１Ｂ」での就労を目指す学生にとって、つなぎの役割を果たすことが多い。トランプ政権はＨ１Ｂビザについても手数料を引き上げている。

規則案の最終決定に先立ち、３０日間の意見公募が行われる。

ＤＨＳは、学校、学生、雇用主が準備する時間を確保するため、最終決定から施行まで６０日間の猶予を設けると説明した。

item.title: テニス＝中国ＯＰ敗退のガウフ、武漢ＯＰ辞退 ネット上で誹謗中傷被害
item.description: ［北京 ７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　７日　ロイター］ - テニスの中国オープン（ＯＰ）は７日、女子シングルス４回戦を行い、第３シードのココ・ガウフ（米国）は第１３シードのエリーズ・メルテンス（ベルギー）に３─６、３─６で敗れた。試合後、疲労を理由に昨年優勝した武漢ＯＰを辞退した。

メルテンス戦では３４本のアンフォーストエラーを犯し、１時間１８分で敗退。武漢ＯＰ辞退についてガウフは「特にディフェンディングチャンピオンとして武漢を棄権するのは残念だ。長いシーズンを戦い、体には休養と回復の時間が必要」と説明した。

ガウフは５日の３回戦で１６歳の中国選手を７─５、６─１で下した後、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）上で大量の人種差別的な中傷を受けたと明かしていた。

この試合では第１セットの重要な局面で、ガウフは広告ボードの点滅を理由にプレーを止め、ビデオ判定の結果、ポイントがやり直しとなった。これを巡ってネット上で批判が殺到したという。

ガウフは記者会見で「正直、かなり消耗した。携帯電話の電源を切って前に進むだけ。できることは何もない」とコメント。女子テニス協会（ＷＴＡ）はロイターへの声明で「テニスに人種差別や差別、中傷の居場所はない。ガウフに向けられた人種差別的な中傷に、われわれはあぜんとしている。全面的に支援するため、本人と連絡を取っている」と述べた。

item.title: 8月経常収支は4兆0620億円の黒字＝財務省
item.description: [東京 ８日 ロイター] - 財務省が８日発表した国際収支状況速報によると、８月の経常収支は４兆０６２０億円の黒字...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
8月経常収支は4兆0620億円の黒字＝財務省 9:05 配信

10月6日、東京港で撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ８日 ロイター] - 財務省が８日発表した国際収支状況速報によると、８月の経常収支は４兆０６２０億円の黒字となった。ロイターが民間調査機関に行った事前調査の予測中央値は３兆１９４６億円程度の黒字だった。貿易・サービス収支は８０３５億円の赤字だった。第１次所得収支は５兆１３３２億円の黒字、第２次所得収支は２６７７億円の赤字だった。

＊この記事の詳細はこの後送信します。新しい記事は「UPDATE」と表示します。

＊財務省の発表資料は以下のＵＲＬでご覧になれます。...

item.title: Suspect behind South Korea bank hacks may be 26-year-old in China, cybersecurity firm says
item.description: The suspect behind recent cyberattacks targeting South Korea's financial sector may be a 26-year-old based in China's Guangdong province, US cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The suspect behind recent cyberattacks targeting South Korea's financial sector may be a 26-year-old based in China's Guangdong province, US cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike (CRWD.O) said. In a report published on its website on Wednesday, CrowdStrike said it uncovered personal details linked to the suspected attacker while analysing AI coding-tool sessions and infrastructure associated with a campaign [USN:L6N45S035 TEXT:"targeting"] South Korean financial institutions from late September to early October. CrowdStrike said the attacker used ARTEX, a recently released Chinese-developed open-source penetration testing tool, alongside large language models and assessed with "moderate confidence" that the actor was a Chinese speaker and likely financially motivated. The firm said one Claude Code session contained a request to create a security researcher resume describing results from the hacking activity. The prompt included details such as a Telegram account, age, education background and a location in Maoming, Guangdong, the report said. CrowdStrike said the same Telegram username appeared in other cyber activity, including vulnerability research involving a Telegram-based NFT marketplace and a separate suspected attack on a Chinese payment platform. The company said the personal details likely belonged to the actor responsible for the activity, but cautioned that currently available information could not definitively identify the attacker. Authorities in Seoul are investigating cyberattacks that affected multiple financial institutions after banks including Shinhan Bank and KB Kookmin Bank reported data breaches. South Korean police, who have launched a probe, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Tuesday that signs had emerged that AI was used in some of the hacking incidents and called for heightened cybersecurity measures.

item.title: FBI prende homem por planejar ataque no shopping Mall of America, perto de Minneapolis
item.description: O FBI prendeu um jovem de 18 anos que planejava realizar um ataque a tiros no shopping Mall of America, perto de Minneapolis, em nome do Estado Islâmico (Isis), de acordo com documentos judiciais.
item.dc:creator: Dan Rosenzweig-Ziff
item.content:encoded: O FBI prendeu um jovem de 18 anos que planejava realizar um ataque a tiros no shopping Mall of America, perto de Minneapolis, em nome do Estado Islâmico (Isis), de acordo com documentos judiciais. Ele foi preso na terça-feira depois que um agente disfarçado do FBI vendeu ao morador de Minnesota Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud um AK-47, munição e carregadores por US$600, segundo a denúncia. Mohamud disse ao informante que planejava usar os itens para matar de 30 a 60 pessoas em um evento no shopping no final de outubro. Mohamud foi acusado de receber conscientemente uma arma de fogo e munição com o objetivo de cometer um ato de terrorismo. Seu advogado não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. De acordo com a denúncia, Mohamud disse a uma fonte do FBI em várias plataformas de mensagens que pretendia viajar para o exterior para lutar em nome do al-Shabaab, uma organização terrorista estrangeira designada como tal. Ele afirmou que, caso não pudesse viajar, planejava realizar um ataque a tiros. Posteriormente, disse que queria se juntar ao Isis. Ele também teria manifestado apoio a um homem que atropelou uma multidão com um caminhão em Nova Orleans em 1º de janeiro de 2025, matando 14 pessoas, antes de ser morto em um tiroteio com a polícia. Em julho, Mohamud teria dito que queria matar de 30 a 60 pessoas no Mall of America porque alegava que seus proprietários eram judeus e que queria matar não-muçulmanos. Ele disse ao informante que planejava um ataque para 24 de outubro porque haveria uma “Celebração das Artes Hmong” naquele dia no shopping. O Mall of America é o maior shopping center dos Estados Unidos, com um parque temático, um aquário e mais de 500 lojas. Na terça-feira, Mohamud teria comprado o AK-47, quatro carregadores com capacidade para 30 cartuchos e cerca de 200 cartuchos de munição de um agente disfarçado do FBI. Logo em seguida, agentes do FBI o prenderam. Mohamud compareceu pela primeira vez ao tribunal nesta quarta-feira, perante a juíza federal Elizabeth Cowan Wright.

item.title: IMF reaches staff deal with Pakistan, potentially unlocking $1.2 billion
item.description: The International Monetary Fund has reached a staff-level agreement with Pakistan on reviews of some of its lending programs, potentially unlocking about $1.21 billion in financing pending board approval, the fund said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund has reached a staff-level agreement with Pakistan on reviews of some of its lending programs, potentially unlocking about $1.21 billion in financing pending board approval, the fund said on Wednesday. If the board approves the deal, Pakistan could access about $1 billion under the Extended Fund Facility and $210 million under the climate-focused Resilience and Sustainability Facility, bringing total disbursements under the two programs to around $5.7 billion. Pakistan remains [USN:L8N4581JR TEXT:"reliant"] on external financing to bolster foreign exchange reserves and meet debt repayments. "Supported by the EFF, the authorities have successfully navigated the impact of the Middle East conflict, and strong policies have helped preserve macroeconomic stability," the fund said. Risks remain elevated, however, due to geopolitical tensions, volatile energy prices, tighter global financial conditions and trade disruptions, the IMF said. Pakistan is the [USN:L1N42K00F TEXT:"most vulnerable"] major Asia-Pacific economy to a prolonged Middle East conflict, given its dependence on Gulf energy imports, remittances and financing support from the region, Ahmad Mobeen, principal economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said earlier this year.

item.title: Tempestade tropical Isaias deve atingir costa dos Estados Unidos como furacão na madrugada do sábado
item.description: A tempestade tropical Isaias se formou no Golfo do México nesta quarta-feira e deve se intensificar, transformando-se em furacão, antes de atingir a costa sul dos Estados Unidos na madrugada de sábado, trazendo fortes chuvas, ondas de tempestade e possíveis tornados em diversos Estados, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC, na sigla em inglês).
item.dc:creator: Brad Brooks, Nathan Crooks
item.content:encoded: A tempestade tropical Isaias se formou no Golfo do México nesta quarta-feira e deve se intensificar, transformando-se em furacão, antes de atingir a costa sul dos Estados Unidos na madrugada de sábado, trazendo fortes chuvas, ondas de tempestade e possíveis tornados em diversos Estados, informou o Centro Nacional de Furacões (NHC, na sigla em inglês). A expectativa é que a tempestade atravesse áreas com significativa produção de petróleo e gás em alto mar, além de instalações de refino em terra firme, o que pode pressionar os estoques e os preços já elevados nos postos de combustível. Michael Brennan, diretor do NHC, disse em uma coletiva em vídeo nesta quarta-feira que Isaias poderia se tornar um furacão “grande” -- de categoria 3 ou superior -- quando atingir o continente e tem potencial de causar “múltiplos impactos com risco de vida, decorrentes de ondas de tempestade, inundações causadas por chuvas intensas e ventos com força de furacão”. Se confirmado, o Isaias será o primeiro furacão da temporada no Atlântico, de acordo com o NHC, e pode empatar o recorde do primeiro furacão atlântico mais tardio com aquele que atingiu a região em 8 de outubro de 1905. O forte fenômeno climático El Niño deste ano inibiu o desenvolvimento de furacões no Atlântico. Cerca de 11,2 milhões de barris de produção de petróleo podem ser perdidos em todo o Golfo durante a tempestade, um aumento significativo em relação aos 7,1 milhões de barris afetados pela tempestade tropical Bertha em julho, de acordo com uma previsão de modelo da empresa de consultoria Earth Science Associates. O NHC prevê que o Isaias se transforme em furacão até quinta-feira, à medida que ganha força rapidamente sobre as águas quentes do Golfo antes de atingir o continente no início da manhã de sábado, provavelmente em algum ponto ao longo da costa do Mississippi, do Alabama ou da Península da Flórida. A tempestade estava localizada a cerca de 805 km ao sul da costa da Louisiana na madrugada desta quarta-feira. O Isaias pode causar chuvas isoladas de até 25,4 cm em partes da costa do Golfo, que se estende da Louisiana até a Península da Flórida, informou o NHC em seu último boletim. É possível que ocorram tornados nas faixas de chuva do Isaias ao longo da Península da Flórida e do Alabama, da noite de sexta-feira até sábado, com mais tornados previstos mais para o interior à medida que a tempestade se move para o norte. A tempestade também pode produzir chuva mais para o interior, com o NHC alertando que “inundações repentinas e urbanas, juntamente com inundações isoladas de rios, serão possíveis” em todo o Sudeste. A expectativa é que o Isaias encontre ventos fortes nas camadas superiores da atmosfera nas últimas 24 horas antes de atingir o norte da Costa do Golfo, o que pode enfraquecer a tempestade. Ainda assim, o NHC afirma que “parece cada vez mais provável que o Isaias seja um furacão significativo quando atingir a costa”. O governador da Flórida, Ron DeSantis, já havia declarado, na terça-feira, estado de emergência para algumas regiões do Estado. Algumas autoridades da região estão pedindo aos moradores que se retirem voluntariamente. O senador da Flórida, Rick Scott, escreveu nas redes sociais que havia conversado com o presidente Donald Trump sobre a tempestade e que “o governo federal vai apoiar a Flórida e garantir que tenhamos tudo o que for necessário para nos prepararmos, reagirmos e nos recuperarmos”. PETRÓLEO E GÁS A Administração de Minerais Marinhos, que monitora as operadoras de petróleo e gás offshore no Golfo do México, informou nesta quarta-feira que funcionários foram retirados de oito plataformas de produção e duas plataformas sem posicionamento dinâmico antes da tempestade. Cerca de 25% da produção atual de petróleo no Golfo, ou 511.619 barris de petróleo por dia, foi interrompida, informou a agência, citando relatórios das operadoras. Pouco mais de 350 milhões de pés cúbicos por dia de produção de gás natural também foram interrompidos, o que representa cerca de 16,4% da produção total da região. Entre as empresas mais expostas à tempestade estão a BP (BP.L) , a Chevron (CVX.N) , a ENI (ENI.MI) , a Murphy Oil (MUR.N) e a Shell (SHEL.L)

item.title: Jose Ramirez stars as Guardians force Game 4 against White Sox
item.description: CHICAGO -- Jo Adell had a bases-clearing triple among his two hits, Jose Ramirez added two hits and two RBIs, and seven pitchers tallied 19 strikeouts as the Cleveland Guardians defeated the Chicago White Sox 9-3 on Wednesday in Game 3 to stay alive in their American League Division Series.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: CHICAGO -- Jo Adell had a bases-clearing triple among his two hits, Jose Ramirez added two hits and two RBIs, and seven pitchers tallied 19 strikeouts as the Cleveland Guardians defeated the Chicago White Sox 9-3 on Wednesday in Game 3 to stay alive in their American League Division Series. Cleveland avoided elimination behind an 11-hit attack that eclipsed the seven hits the Guardians collected in the first two games of the series. Chicago leads the best-of-five ALDS 2-1 but missed an opportunity to clinch a postseason series at home for the first time since the 1906 World Series. The White Sox went 2-for-11 with runners in scoring position. Game 4 is Thursday in Chicago. Guardians closer Cade Smith had five strikeouts while working the final two innings. Foster Griffin struck out seven in 2 2/3 innings and Tim Herrin fanned the side in a perfect seventh. Chicago's Munetaka Murakami, Tristan Peters and Colson Montgomery each had three strikeouts and four other White Sox whiffed twice. Ramirez doubled in the fifth for his first hit of the series and contributed a sparkling defensive play in the sixth. With the bases loaded and a run in, Chicago's Miguel Vargas smashed a two-out liner to third on a 3-2 pitch. Ramirez dove to his left to snare the drive and preserve a 5-3 lead. Ramirez's two-run triple in the eighth put the game away before a raucous crowd of 40,590, most of whom were hoping to see the resurgent White Sox advance to the American League Championship Series after three consecutive 100-loss seasons. White Sox opener Sean Newcomb retired the side on 10 pitches in the first and faced the minimum in the second after Nathaniel Lowe lined into a double play at third base. Cleveland broke through against a pair of other Chicago left-handers in the third, capitalizing on three combined walks from Bryan Hudson and Hagen Smith. Three batters after Steven Kwan delivered a game-tying single, Adell punctuated the rally, grounding Smith's 1-2 pitch for an opposite-field, bases-clearing triple down the line in right for a 4-1 lead. Playing at Rate Field for the first time since the regular-season finale Sept. 27, the White Sox scored a first-inning run on Kyle Teel's RBI double. Chicago appeared to have Guardians opener Daniel Espino on the ropes but Cleveland stranded two runners in scoring position to end the inning. Espino struck out Chase Meidroth before yielding to Foster Griffin, who caught Peters looking. Griffin (1-0) helped Cleveland flip the script on Chicago's early postseason mastery of bullpen games. The left-hander recorded seven of his eight outs via strikeout while allowing one run and two hits in 2 2/3 innings. Patrick Bailey and Brayan Rocchio had two hits apiece for the Guardians. Hudson (1-1) took the loss as White Sox pitching issued 10 walks. --Kevin Druley, Field Level Media

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro suma respaldo de dos partidos de centro-derecha antes de segunda vuelta en Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sumó el respaldo de União Brasil y PP, un día después del apoyo de Ronaldo Caiado, mientras busca ampliar su base para enfrentar a Lula en la segunda vuelta del 25 de octubre.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Carvalho, Augusta Saraiva
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El candidato presidencial brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro obtuvo el miércoles el respaldo de dos partidos de centro-derecha, un día después de que un veterano legislador le diera su apoyo, lo que refuerza su campaña de cara a una reñida segunda vuelta. El partido União Brasil y el Partido de los Progresistas (PP) han respaldado al candidato de derecha, según declaró la senadora Tereza Cristina Dias a los periodistas en Brasilia. Bolsonaro afirma que respetará la Constitución y la política del país, al tiempo que se ha comprometido a ejercer únicamente un mandato como jefe de Estado si resulta elegido en la segunda vuelta del 25 de octubre. “Habrá estabilidad, paz para que todos puedan trabajar, así como respeto por la Constitución”, declaró Bolsonaro a los periodistas. “Brasil volverá a la normalidad”. Ver más: Acciones de Brasil reciben flujo récord de US$2.010 millones tras la primera vuelta electoral Bolsonaro está tratando de consolidar el apoyo y contrarrestar las críticas sobre su falta de experiencia en el gobierno, mientras se prepara para enfrentarse al actual presidente de izquierdas, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, en la segunda vuelta. El martes se aseguró el respaldo del exgobernador del estado de Goiás y ex candidato presidencial Ronaldo Caiado, y afirmó que también se había reunido con miembros de los partidos de centro Republicanos y Podemos. La campaña espera cerrar los apoyos de los partidos políticos para el jueves. Este apoyo podría resultar significativo en la próxima segunda vuelta, dado que a Bolsonaro le faltaron menos de tres puntos porcentuales para alcanzar la mayoría absoluta necesaria para ganar el cargo más alto del país en la primera vuelta celebrada el domingo. Ver más: Resultado de Bolsonaro en Brasil abre la puerta a un giro en el comercio de materias primas El martes, Bolsonaro afirmó que podría recurrir a una mayoría en el Congreso para enmendar la Constitución si llega a ser presidente. Las elecciones han dado lugar a una legislatura más inclinada hacia la derecha, lo que aumenta la posibilidad de obtener mayorías tanto en el Senado como en la Cámara Baja y de elegir a los presidentes de ambas cámaras, señaló. El miércoles, señaló las reformas judiciales, fiscales y de seguridad pública, así como la iniciativa de limitar la presidencia a un único mandato, como medidas que llevaría a cabo y que requerirían cambios constitucionales. -Con la colaboración de Gabriel Teixeira de Melo. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: 独政府、中国コスコの物流企業買収を阻止 安保上の懸念で
item.description: [ベルリン ７日 ロイター] - ドイツ経済省は７日、中国国有海運大手の中国遠洋海運集団（コスコ）による物流企業ツィ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独政府、中国コスコの物流企業買収を阻止　安保上の懸念で 8:46 配信

中国遠洋海運集団（コスコ）のロゴで2025年9月撮影。 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov

[ベルリン ７日 ロイター] - ドイツ経済省は７日、中国国有海運大手の中国遠洋海運集団（コスコ）による物流企業ツィッペルの買収を安全保障上の懸念から阻止したと発表した。

声明で「買収が実現すれば依存が深まり、ドイツと欧州連合（ＥＵ）のサプライチェーン（供給網）の強靱性が損なわれる恐れがあった」と説明した。

欧州各国政府は、中国国有企業による物流・輸送インフラへの投資に警戒を強めている。供給網に関する機微な情報へのアクセスを許し、依存関係を招く恐れがあるとの懸念が背景にある。

ドイツ連邦カルテル庁は２月にこの案件を承認したが、国家安全保障上の問題は管轄外だとしていた。

コスコはツィッペル株８０％の取得を目指していた。

コスコのコメントは得られていない。同社は既にハンブルク港のコンテナターミナルの少数株式を保有している。２０２３年に当時の政権が、連立政権内で強い反対論があったにもかかわらず取得を承認した。

item.title: サッカー＝元スペイン代表ＦＷペドロ、現役引退 10年Ｗ杯制覇
item.description: ［７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［７日　ロイター］ - サッカーの元スペイン代表ＦＷペドロ・ロドリゲス（３９）が７日、現役引退を発表した。

ペドロは交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）の声明で、「今がその時だと感じている。一歩踏み出し、人生の新たな章を始める時だ。夢を実現できたこと、そしてその実現のために支えてくれた全ての人々を誇りに思いながらこの場を去ることができる。私をこれほど幸せにしてくれたサッカーに感謝したい」と述べた。

２００８年にバルセロナ（スペイン）のトップチームに昇格したペドロは、当時チームを指揮していたジョゼップ・グアルディオラ監督の下で才能を開花させ、同クラブで２０個の主要タイトルを獲得した。１５年に移籍したチェルシー（イングランド）ではプレミアリーグ優勝を経験。ローマでのプレーを経て、２１年からラツィオ（ともにイタリア）で５年間プレーした後、７月に契約満了でフリーとなっていた。

クラブレベルでは通算７９４試合に出場し、１９７得点を記録。１０年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）と１２年欧州選手権（ＥＵＲＯ）で優勝に貢献したスペイン代表としては、６５試合に出場して１７得点を挙げた。

item.title: 英シェル、第3四半期の精製マージンは過去最高の見通し
item.description: [７日 ロイター] - 英石油大手シェルは７日、２０２６年第３・四半期の精製マージンが１バレル当たり４２ドルで、前四半期...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英シェル、第3四半期の精製マージンは過去最高の見通し 8:44 配信

１０月２日、ロンドンのガソリンスタンドに掲げられたシェルのロゴ。 REUTERS/Toby Melville

[７日 ロイター] - 英石油大手シェルは７日、２０２６年第３・四半期の精製マージンが１バレル当たり４２ドルで、前四半期の２４ドルを大幅に上回って過去最高になるとの見通しを示した。米国・イスラエルとイランの戦争によって燃料供給が逼迫し、価格が上昇したことが要因だ。

エネルギー価格高騰で売り上げが増えた石油大手各社は、中東紛争が数十億ドル規模の増収要因となると見込まれている。

シェルは第３・四半期の統合ガス生産量見通しを日量７４万─７８万バレル石油換算バレルとし、従来予想の５７万─６３万石油換算バレルから引き上げた。前四半期の生産量は６３万１０００石油換算バレルだったが、中東紛争前は９０万石油換算バレルを超えていた。

シェルは９月２日に１６４億ドルで買収を完了したカナダのエネルギー企業ＡＲＣリソーシズの生産量も統合ガス生産量見通しに含まれていると説明している。

第３・四半期の液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）生産量は７２０万―７６０万トン程度になると見込んだ。従来予想は７１０万―７７０万トンで、前四半期の生産量は７７０万トンだった。

石油をはじめとする上流部門の生産量見通しは日量１７４万─１８４万石油換算バレルとした。従来予想は１６８万―１８８万石油換算バレルだった。

一方、第３・四半期の化学品・製品部門の製油所稼働率は前期を下回るとみられる。ライン川の水位低下がラインラント製油所の稼働率に悪影響を及ぼしており、全体の足を引っ張る。

ＲＢＣのアナリストらはリポートで「ＡＲＣ買収による１カ月分の寄与を含めて上流部門の生産量が増加したことで、生産量見通しは市場予想を上回っている。またトレーディング部門の業績は（２０２６年第２・四半期並みの）高水準であることから、キャッシュフローの創出を支えるとみられる」とし、「全体として、キャッシュフローは市場予想よりも堅調なように見える」とコメントした。

item.title: LG Energy Solution flags 26% rise in Q3 operating profit
item.description: South Korean battery maker LG Energy Solution said on Thursday the company expects its July-September operating profit to rise 25.7% to 756 billion won ($564.09 million).
item.dc:creator: Heekyong Yang, Heejin Kim
item.content:encoded: South Korean battery maker LG Energy Solution (373220.KS) said on Thursday the company expects its July-September operating profit to rise 25.7% to 756 billion won ($564.09 million). That compared with an LSEG SmartEstimate forecast for an operating profit of 309 billion won, which is weighted toward analysts who are more consistently accurate. Here are some details: • LGES, which supplies Tesla (TSLA.O) , General Motors (GM.N) and Hyundai Motor (005380.KS) among others, has been grappling with a prolonged slowdown in EV demand. • Revenue likely rose 59% to 9.6 trillion won from a year earlier, according to LGES' regulatory filing. • The quarterly earnings guidance includes tax credits provided under the US Inflation Reduction Act for the company's battery production in the United States, LGES said in a statement. Excluding those credits, the company would have posted an operating profit of 339.1 billion won. • Analysts attributed the better-than-expected operating profit to a one-off gain from a North American automaker, which paid compensation for falling short of minimum purchase commitments amid weak EV demand. • To offset weakness in the EV market, LGES has been expanding its energy storage system (ESS) business, where demand is being supported by rising electricity needs from artificial intelligence data centres. • Analysts said AI-driven data centre demand for ESS is emerging as a growth driver for battery makers. However, they cautioned that LGES' ESS business remains loss-making and that the timing of a turnaround has been pushed back. • LGES said it plans to announce detailed quarterly results on November 3. ($1 = 1,340.2200 won)

item.title: ゴルフ＝元世界ランク1位のラーム、ＬＩＶ離脱へ 未払い11億円超
item.description: ［７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［７日　ロイター］ - 男子ゴルフの元世界ランキング１位、ジョン・ラーム（スペイン）が超高額賞金ツアーの「ＬＩＶゴルフ」を離脱する意向を示した。代理人が７日、米破産裁判所で明らかにした。

ＬＩＶは現在、連邦破産法１１条の適用下で再建を進めており、次期構想「ＬＩＶ２．０」を計画している。

代理人は、ラームが同構想の条件を独自に検討した結果、「受け入れられない」と判断し、今後参加しない方針だと説明した。

ラームは２０２３年末にＬＩＶへ加入。その前にはマスターズ・トーナメントを制し、メジャー２勝目を挙げていた。ＬＩＶ加入後は３季連続で年間個人王者となった。

ＬＩＶの破産申請では、ラームへの未払い分は選手で最大の７５０万ドル（約１１億６０００万円）と記載された。セルヒオ・ガルシア（スペイン）とはすでに契約解除で合意しており、ブライソン・デシャンボー（米国）ら複数選手も旧契約の解除を裁判所に求めている。

item.title: Banco Central peruano mantiene tasa en 4,25% por más de un año, contrario a expectativas
item.description: El Banco Central de Reserva de Perú informó el miércoles que dejó estable su tasa de interés en 4,25%, extendiendo una pausa por poco más de un año, a pesar de las previsiones de los analistas de un aumento de 25 puntos básicos mientras la inflación de mantiene por encima de su rango meta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Banco Central de Reserva de Perú informó el miércoles que dejó estable su tasa de interés en 4,25%, extendiendo una pausa por poco más de un año, a pesar de las previsiones de los analistas de un aumento de 25 puntos básicos mientras la inflación de mantiene por encima de su rango meta. Analistas consultados por Reuters esperaban la primera alza de la tasa desde inicios del 2023, cuando tocaba máximos de 7,75% y comenzara a reducir gradualmente los tipos de interés. El banco anunció que mantuvo la tasa sin cambios, a pesar de que la inflación interanual aumentó de 4,4% en agosto a 4,5% en septiembre, principalmente por el incremento de los precios de combustibles y electricidad; mientras que la inflación sin alimentos y energía se mantuvo en 4,5%; aunque si se excluye el rubro de transporte la tasa permaneció en 1,8% interanual. El rango meta de inflación del banco es de entre 1% y 3%. "El desvío de la inflación respecto del rango meta responde principalmente al alza de los precios de los combustibles y a sus efectos sobre los costos de transporte en marzo y abril", afirmó. Las expectativas de inflación a doce meses se mantuvieron en 3,1 por ciento en setiembre, ligeramente por encima del límite superior del rango meta de inflación, acotó. El banco indicó que se proyecta que tanto la inflación interanual como la inflación sin alimentos y energía retornen al rango meta y se ubiquen alrededor de 2% "en el horizonte de proyección", conforme se vayan disipando los efectos de los choques de oferta que afectaron la inflación. "Sin embargo, existe el riesgo de que el Fenómeno de El Niño y las tensiones geopolíticas en el Medio Oriente tengan efectos más persistentes sobre la inflación" señaló la entidad. El banco dijo que indicadores adelantados de la actividad económica local a setiembre siguen mostrando un buen desempeño; y que los riesgos globales se mantienen elevados, lo que se refleja en una mayor volatilidad de los mercados financieros. Perú, que tiene una de las tasas de interés y de su costo de vida más bajos de América Latina, tuvo una inflación del 1,5% el año pasado, y el banco central espera que el precio al consumidor cierre el 2026 en un 4,2%, según su última previsión.

item.title: オアシス、ニデックに非公開化の初期的検討を要請
item.description: [東京 ８日 ロイター] - 香港の投資ファンド、オアシス・マネジメントは７日、ニデックの取締役会に対し、非公開化に向...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
オアシス、ニデックに非公開化の初期的検討を要請 8:40 配信

9月9日、都内のニデックのオフィス。 REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京 ８日 ロイター] - 香港の投資ファンド、オアシス・マネジメントは７日、ニデックの取締役会に対し、非公開化に向けた初期的検討を開始するよう要請すると発表した。同社の有価証券報告書に独立監査人から「意見不表明」が付され、適正意見を自力で取得できる保証がない中、「意図せぬ上場廃止リスク」に備えるべきだと主張した。

ニデックが９月３０日に提出した有価証券報告書に対しＰＷＣジャパン監査法人は、連結財務諸表に対する意見表明の基礎となる材料が十分にないなどとして監査意見を表明しなかった。監査で指摘された、不正会計に関与・指示した役員・従業員が財務報告プロセスに「引き続き責任ある立場にいる」 ことなどに対し、オアシスは「衝撃を受けるとともに深く失望している」と表明した。

オアシスによると、２０２５年１２月以降、ニデックに対し非公開化の検討を求めてきた。今回の要求は、非公開化を直ちに決定するよう求めるものではなく、社外取締役が主導して国内外の事業会社やプライベートエクイティ会社から法的拘束力のない初期的な提案を募ることを求めるものだとしている。

オアシスは、９月９日時点でニデック株の７．９７％を保有している。

item.title: McKenzie starts at flyhalf for first Bledisloe test after Mo'unga injury
item.description: Damian McKenzie will start at flyhalf for the All Blacks against the Wallabies in the first Bledisloe Cup test at Eden Park on Saturday after Richie Mo'unga was ruled out by an injury suffered in training.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Damian McKenzie will start at flyhalf for the All Blacks against the Wallabies in the first Bledisloe Cup test at Eden Park on Saturday after Richie Mo'unga was ruled out by an injury suffered in training. Coach Dave Rennie's preferred starter Ruben Love has been sidelined by an ankle injury so Mo'unga had been expected to start until he suffered a calf injury on Tuesday. Former captain Scott Barrett returns to the team for the first time since last November, starting in the second row with Josh Lord. Tupou Vaa'i, Wallace Sititi and Peter Lakai make up a new-look back row in the absence through injury of Luke Jacobson and Ardie Savea, who has been ruled out for the rest of the year. Quinn Tupaea returns from injury to join Jordie Barrett in the centres. Leroy Carter and Will Jordan will play on the wings with Beauden Barrett starting at fullback. Shannon Frizell returns to the team for the first time since the 2023 World Cup final after a spell in Japan. He will provide back row cover from the bench with Anton Segner. New Zealand have held the Bledisloe Cup since 2003 and have not lost a test to Australia at Auckland's Eden Park since 1986. The second test in this year's series is in Sydney on October 17. "The Bledisloe Cup means a huge amount to this group. There's a lot of history and pride tied up in it, and every test against the Wallabies carries real weight for us," said Rennie, who previously coached Australia. "We have huge respect for this Australian side and the way they have been playing. We know we'll need to be at our best." 15-Beauden Barrett, 14-Will Jordan, 13-Quinn Tupaea, 12-Jordie Barrett, 11-Leroy Carter, 10-Damian McKenzie, 9-Cam Roigard, 8-Wallace Sititi, 7-Peter Lakai, 6-Tupou Vaa'i, 5-Josh Lord, 4-Scott Barrett, 3-Fletcher Newell, 2-Codie Taylor (captain), 1-Ethan de Groot. Replacements: 16-Asafo Aumua, 17-George Bower, 18-Pasilio Tosi, 19-Shannon Frizell, 20-Anton Segner, 21-Kyle Preston, 22-Rieko Ioane, 23-Josh Moorby.

item.title: Gavin McKenna, Leafs get first road test vs. Pacific-leading Knights
item.description: After splitting four home games to begin the season, the Toronto Maple Leafs start a three-game western road trip when they face the Golden Knights on Thursday in Las Vegas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: After splitting four home games to begin the season, the Toronto Maple Leafs start a three-game western road trip when they face the Golden Knights on Thursday in Las Vegas. The baggage for the flight to Sin City will no doubt feel a lot lighter for 18-year-old Toronto forward Gavin McKenna. After going scoreless in his first three games, the highly touted No. 1 pick in the 2026 NHL Draft scored his first goal and added an assist, helping Toronto rally from a 3-0 deficit to defeat the Nashville Predators 5-4 in overtime on Tuesday. McKenna snapped a laser from just above the right faceoff dot over the right shoulder of Predators goalie Juuse Saros and into the top far corner of the net at the 14:31 mark of the second period to cut Nashville's lead to 4-3. Jack Roslovic tied the game midway through the third period before Matthews scored with 14 seconds remaining in overtime. Matthews also had three assists, including the primary helper on McKenna's goal. Although Matthews finished with a four-point game and the game-winning goal, McKenna was named the first star of the game. He received a loud standing ovation from the sellout crowd at Scotiabank Arena as he came out to take a lap. "A big monkey off the back, that one felt good," McKenna said. "That's a goal I'll obviously remember forever." "That was a goal-scorer's goal," Toronto coach Jim Hiller said. "The guys were really excited for him but more importantly it was a big goal in the hockey game. That one you remember. It was really important." The breakthrough eased some of the pressure that had been building on McKenna following his scoreless start. "When you go a few games and you haven't found the scoresheet, it's tough," Matthews said. "It can weigh on you. But at the same time, he just kept sticking with it, and obviously he found it tonight. "I think you're going to see him go on a bit of a tear here now, because that weight's lifted off your shoulders," Matthews added. "You can kind of just focus, and just go play." Now McKenna plays his first NHL road game on the big stage against a Vegas team that lost in six games to Carolina in the Stanley Cup Final in June. The Golden Knights, first in the Pacific Division with six points, return home after sweeping a two-game Pacific Northwest trip, edging Vancouver 3-2 on Sunday, followed by a 6-2 victory at Seattle on Tuesday. Tomas Hertl had two goals and two assists, and Jack Eichel also had a four-point game with a breakaway goal and three assists against the Kraken. Captain Mark Stone added a Gordie Howe hat trick with a goal, an assist and a fighting major for his bout with Brandon Montour. The game featured 65 minutes in penalties and a number of scuffles after Seattle's Ben Meyers picked up a five-minute boarding penalty and a game misconduct for a hard check that sent Victor Olofsson flying into the boards. Olofsson, who had scored twice and leads the team with four goals, had to be helped off the ice with a lower-body injury and didn't return. "It's tough to see 'Oley' going down," Hertl said. "Hopefully it's nothing serious because he's had a heckuva start to the season." Vegas coach Ryan Craig said he'd have an update on Olofsson on Thursday. The road sweep came after the Golden Knights lost 4-3 to Anaheim last Friday. "It was a good road trip for us," Stone said. "It's good to finally get rewarded tonight, too, right? I thought we had quite a few chances in the first three games, but we didn't bury the teams when we had the chances." --Field Level Media

item.title: 仏財務相、新規国債発行は「戦略的」アプローチで＝ＷＳＪ
item.description: [７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[７日 ロイター] - フランスのレスキュール財務相は、米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が７日に掲載したインタビューで、新規国債の発行に「戦略的」なアプローチを取ると述べた。国債への売り圧力は世界的に強まっており、借り入れコストが数十年ぶりの高水準に押し上げられている。

ＷＳＪは、フランスが償還期間の短い国債の発行を増やすことを検討していると報じたが、財務省は発行計画に変更はなく、引き続き市場の需要に対応する方針だと説明した。

レスキュール氏はインタビューで「（利回り）曲線上の価値を踏まえて合理的に判断すれば、償還期間を短くすることになるだろう」と指摘。その上で「ただ、あくまで小幅な調整だ。われわれはトレーダーではない」と語った。

財務省はその後、財務相発言について補足説明し、国債入札に参加するプライマリーディーラーから、償還期間が３０年を超える国債への需要がここ数カ月低下しているとの指摘があり、最近はこうした国債の発行を減らしていると述べた。

また、中長期国債の発行時の償還期間は、過去２年間でやや短くなっているものの、長期的にはおおむね安定しているとした。

item.title: Colombia reporta inflación en septiembre inferior a la esperada por el mercado, acumula 6,29% anual
item.description: Colombia registró una inflación de 0,37% en septiembre, inferior a la esperada por el mercado, impulsada principalmente por las divisiones de educación, alimentos y bebidas no alcohólicas, así como de alojamiento, agua, electricidad y gas, informó el miércoles el Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Colombia registró una inflación de 0,37% en septiembre, inferior a la esperada por el mercado, impulsada principalmente por las divisiones de educación, alimentos y bebidas no alcohólicas, así como de alojamiento, agua, electricidad y gas, informó el miércoles el Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE). El dato se compara con una variación de 0,32% reportada en septiembre del año pasado y de 0,39% en agosto último. Según la mediana de un sondeo de Reuters, el mercado esperaba una inflación de 0,39% para el noveno mes de este año. El comportamiento en septiembre se explicó por un incremento de 1,43% en los precios de la educación, de 0,78% en los de los alimentos y las bebidas no alcohólicas y de 0,31% en los de alojamiento, agua, electricidad y gas. Los precios en los restaurantes y hoteles subieron 0,23%, los del transporte 0,13%, los de la salud 0,12% y los del vestuario 0,10%. En contraste, los costos de la información y la comunicación bajaron 0,02% y los de la recreación y la cultura 0,21%, precisó el DANE. En el acumulado entre enero y septiembre, la inflación alcanzó un 5,74%, en comparación con el 4,55% en el mismo periodo de 2025. Por su parte, en los últimos 12 meses hasta septiembre, la inflación acumuló un 6,29%, superior al 5,18% en el mismo periodo del año previo y más del doble de la meta puntual establecida por el Banco Central, de 3%. Las presiones inflacionarias fueron la principal razón por la que el Banco Central sorprendió a finales de septiembre con un incremento de 25 puntos básicos en su tasa de interés de referencia, a un 12,25%, su nivel más alto desde febrero de 2024, con lo que acumuló un alza total de 300 puntos básicos desde enero. Las expectativas de inflación en la cuarta economía de América Latina para el cierre de este año aumentaron a un 6,86% en un reciente sondeo de Reuters, desde el 6,76% en la consulta anterior, lo que llevaría al país a incumplir la meta del Banco Central por sexto año consecutivo.

item.title: US lobbies allies to cut ties to anti-disinformation conference over panel critical of Washington, sources say
item.description: The US State Department lobbied Canada and European allies to withdraw support for an anti-disinformation conference because it included a panel examining Washington's role as an alleged information threat to Europe, according to three US officials familiar with the matter and correspondence reviewed by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Humeyra Pamuk
item.content:encoded: The US State Department lobbied Canada and European allies to withdraw support for an anti-disinformation conference because it included a panel examining Washington's role as an alleged information threat to Europe, according to three US officials familiar with the matter and correspondence reviewed by Reuters. State Department officials spent several days prodding their counterparts in Lithuania, Canada and France about the October 7-8 conference , which was organized by EU DisinfoLab, a Brussels-based nonprofit group whose stated mission is "understanding and tackling disinformation," according to the sources and the correspondence. American diplomats persuaded the Canadian and Lithuanian foreign ministries — which had been listed as the conference's "main supporters" — to distance themselves, the officials said. US Ambassador to Lithuania, Kara McDonald, was involved in the outreach to Vilnius, two US officials said. The European Union's External Action Service — the bloc's foreign service — also disappeared from the list of conference supporters, although Reuters could not determine whether the State Department had been in touch. The French government is still listed as the conference's only remaining "main supporter." The panel discussion in question — which followed a scheduled address by an International Criminal Court judge sanctioned by the United States — was entitled "USA as a FIMI threat: acknowledge, adapt, push back." FIMI is an industry acronym for "foreign information manipulation and interference." The conference program, which has been public since at least September 9, said that the panel discussion was meant to cover "one of the most uncomfortable questions in the counter-disinformation field today: how did the United States become a FIMI threat for Europe?" The State Department said that while it was "unable to comment on the details of diplomatic conversations, it should not be a surprise that countries would disaffiliate from this conference" after learning that the US had been labeled a disinformation threat. Using that kind of language "undermines shared goals and should alarm those involved," the State Department said. In a statement, Global Affairs Canada said that while its officials were still participating in the DisinfoLab conference, it had decided to "revise its participation" in several panel discussions at the conference following what it said were "changes to the framing" of those events. The Lithuanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement that it had canceled its participation in the conference "as several parts of the conference programme differ from the official position of the Government." The French and EU officials did not immediately return messages seeking comment. EU DisinfoLab did not immediately return a message sent after business hours in Europe. The State Department's role in lobbying foreign governments over the conference was first reported by the Guardian.

item.title: US Forces in Okinawa Face Curfew After Marine’s Arrest
item.description: The US Forces in Okinawa paused operations for 48 hours starting at noon on Wednesday and imposed a month-long curfew on military personnel, following the arrest of a US Marine on suspicion of murdering a Japanese woman.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- The US Forces in Okinawa paused operations for 48 hours starting at noon on Wednesday and imposed a month-long curfew on military personnel, following the arrest of a US Marine on suspicion of murdering a Japanese woman.US military personnel on Japan’s southernmost island of Okinawa will cease operations to undergo training on standards and discipline and will be prohibited from leaving their bases to socialize or from consuming alcohol, according to a statement.“Serving on Okinawa comes with responsibility,” the statement read. “Every interaction with our neighbors either builds or undermines the trust that is essential to our team. When that trust is damaged, it affects the strength of our alliance and the security of this region.”Following the operational pause, military personnel will be subject to a midnight curfew for a 30-day period, the statement added.Local police arrested a 20-year-old US serviceman on suspicion of killing 39-year-old Anna Yagi early Saturday at a hotel in the city of Naha. National broadcaster NHK said the serviceman denied the charges, citing police investigators.The incident threatens to reignite local opposition to the US military presence on Okinawa, where around 30,000 American service members are based. The rape of a 12-year-old Okinawan girl by three US troops in 1995 triggered major protests, and serious crimes involving US military personnel since then have periodically stoked opposition to the American military presence on the island.Ahead of a meeting Wednesday with Okinawa Governor Genta Koja, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi offered condolences to the bereaved family and said her government had lodged a strong protest with Washington. Japan demanded full cooperation with the investigation, strict disciplinary action against US military personnel, thorough measures to prevent a recurrence of such incidents, and appropriate support for the victim’s family, she said.“As a result, the US side announced new measures,” Takaichi said. “We understand that the US side intends to further scrutinize its code of conduct going forward.”Koja earlier met with Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi and Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi in Tokyo. Ahead of those meetings, Koja said, “This is the result of a failure of human rights training by the US military, given this happened despite repeated requests from the Okinawan side to ensure similar cases are prevented.”Koja became governor only last month after a campaign in which the long-running dispute over US bases took a back seat to other issues.“I feel deep frustration that such a heinous and deplorable crime has occurred, and an American serviceman was arrested in connection to it,” Koizumi said. “I hope to push forward discussions between Japan and the US on what measures will be effective in preventing such cases in the future.”(Adds meeting between Okinawa Governor Koja and Takaichi.)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: Giants WR Malik Nabers sits out practice with 'sore' right knee
item.description: A sore right knee -- the same knee he underwent surgery on for a torn ACL and meniscus in October 2025 -- kept New York Giants star wide receiver Malik Nabers out of practice Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A sore right knee -- the same knee he underwent surgery on for a torn ACL and meniscus in October 2025 -- kept New York Giants star wide receiver Malik Nabers out of practice Wednesday. Following the team's two-hour practice in preparation for Sunday's game at the Washington Commanders, the Pro Bowl receiver appeared to walk with a slight limp but told reporters he was "just sore." "We'll see how the next day goes, but through the week, I'm usually sore," he added. "But this one was kind of a little bit more sore, but I always continue to fight through it." Nabers, 23, tore his ACL while attempting to make a catch against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sept. 28, 2025. He underwent a cleanup procedure in April, then returned to the field for the start of training camp and was in the starting lineup in Week 1. Nabers produced his best game since his return in Sunday's 36-24 home victory over the Arizona Cardinals, hauling in six of seven targets for 112 yards and a score. He has 18 receptions, one touchdown and a team-leading 208 yards in four games. In Sunday's game, fellow Giants receiver Braxton Berrios sustained a season-ending foot injury. When told of Nabers' knee soreness, coach John Harbaugh said, "I'll take him at his word then." "He's doing great, yeah," Harbaugh said. "He had a great day. Great spirits today. He had a good work day." Nabers, 23, is in his third season after being selected sixth overall by the Giants in the 2024 NFL Draft. He was a Pro Bowler as a rookie and has amassed 145 receptions for 1,683 yards and 10 touchdowns in his 23 career games (21 starts). In other injury news for the Giants, defensive lineman Chauncey Golston is exploring his options after suffering a neck injury against the Cardinals. "Chauncey Golston's neck injury ‘could be' long term; he's getting second opinions," Harbaugh told reporters. Golston, 28, is in his second season with the Giants and has 12 tackles in four games (two starts). In 78 games (19 starts) with the Dallas Cowboys (2021-24) and the Giants, the 2021 third-round pick has 167 tackles, one interception, seven passes defensed, two fumble recoveries and 18 quarterback hits. --Field Level Media

item.title: 米国防長官、空母乗組員の忍耐力を称賛 寄港なしの最長派遣終え
item.description:
Phil Stewart
[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Phil Stewart

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - ヘグセス米国防長官は７日、米空母エイブラハム・リンカーンを空路で訪れ、飛行甲板上で、長期にわたる戦時派遣に耐えた乗組員の忍耐力を称賛した。この派遣は艦内での自殺未遂を巡って注目を集めていた。

リンカーンは８日にサンディエゴに帰港する予定。海軍によると、同艦を旗艦とする空母打撃群では、洋上任務中に米兵による自殺未遂が８件あった。国防総省によると、派遣期間中に寄港せず２６０日を超えて連続航行し、最長記録を更新した。

日頃から演説でメディアを批判しているヘグセス氏は、記者らがリンカーン打撃群の乗員を戦争の英雄ではなく、機能不全や任務失敗の象徴に仕立てようとしていると非難した。その上で、イラン戦争での功績をたたえるトランプ米大統領からの表彰状を授与した。

ヘグセス氏によると、リンカーンの戦果には、イランの軍艦６４隻の撃沈、対艦巡航ミサイル２１発の破壊、３６９３回の戦闘出撃、巡航ミサイル「トマホーク」４５０発の発射、イランに対する１３７万ポンドの弾薬使用が含まれる。

同氏は、激しい戦闘作戦の展開ペースにもかかわらず、死傷者も航空機事故もなかったと述べた。

海軍の派遣期間は通常６─９カ月だが、紛争時には延長されることがある。長期派遣中のメンタルヘルスの問題は、米海軍にとって長年の課題となっている。

ヘグセス氏は、空母の帰港を前に「皆さんと帰宅の間に立ちはだかっているのは私だけだ」と冗談を飛ばし、派遣期間を繰り返し延長する命令に署名したのも自分だと語った。

「皆さんには家族に会う権利があり、一刻も早く会うべきだ」と述べ、自身は「帰港する途中で少しだけ会い、ただ感謝を伝えたかった」と説明した。

item.title: 新興国市場の資金フロー、9月は純流出 ＦＲＢタカ派姿勢で＝ＩＩＦ
item.description: [ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - 国際金融協会（ＩＩＦ）が７日公表した報告書によると、９月の新興国債券・株式に対する外国...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
新興国市場の資金フロー、9月は純流出　ＦＲＢタカ派姿勢で＝ＩＩＦ 8:28 配信

ワシントンにある連邦準備銀行。2012年4月撮影。 REUTERS/Joshua Roberts

[ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - 国際金融協会（ＩＩＦ）が７日公表した報告書によると、９月の新興国債券・株式に対する外国人投資家の資金フローは２６３億ドルの純流出となった。月間での流出超過は６月以来。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のタカ派姿勢を受け、米国債利回りとドルが上昇したことが背景にある。

新興国債券市場からの非居住者による資金流出額は７０億ドル。流出超過は、中東紛争の激化で世界の市場に動揺が広がった３月以来となった。

新興国市場は９月、ウォーシュ議長率いるＦＲＢが２０２３年以来となる利上げを決定し、インフレが引き続き懸念材料だと示唆したのを受けて圧力にさらされた。ＦＲＢの利上げを受けて米国債利回りとドルが上昇し、投資家は一部のリスク資産から資金を引き揚げた。

ＩＩＦは報告書で「ＦＯＭＣの決定があった週にハードカレンシー（国際通貨）建て債券ファンドが資金流出に転じ、新興国のドル建てクレジットスプレッドが拡大したことから、月後半に圧力が強まった」と指摘。

今後については「ウォーシュ議長率いるタカ派的なＦＲＢが追加利上げを見込み、日銀の政策金利は１９９５年以来の高水準にあり、先進国全般で金融引き締めが進む中、第４・四半期の新興国キャリー取引のハードルは高まる」との見方を示した。

一方、韓国株に対する海外勢の大幅な売りが影響し、９月の新興国株式からの資金流出は１９２億ドルに達した。

ＩＩＦは「海外投資家による韓国株売りは年初からほぼ一貫して続いている。韓国総合株価指数（ＫＯＳＰＩ）が年初来６２％上昇した後、９月に売りがピークに達した」と指摘した。

この資金流出はアジアの複数の市場を今年押し上げてきた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連のハイテク株高が一服した時期とも重なり、投資家は割高な半導体株やハイテク株の利益確定に動いた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：韓国半導体大手2社の巨額還元、「コリア・ディスカウント」是正の試金石 アングル：韓国レバレッジ株式ＥＴＦ、規制措置導入でも100億ドル超が流入 アングル：韓国個人投資家、7月の国内株暴落で米国株投資再び加速 アングル：ＡＩブームに乗った新興国市場、ハイテク偏重でボラティリティー上昇 最終更新: 10/8(木) 8:32 ロイター

item.title: Australia's ASIC halts fundraising by three ASCF private credit funds
item.description: Australia's corporate regulator issued an interim stop order against fundraising by three managed investment schemes offered by Australian Secure Capital Fund Limited, or ASCF, on Thursday, citing concerns that disclosure documents provided to retail investors may be defective.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's corporate regulator issued an interim stop order against fundraising by three managed investment schemes offered by Australian Secure Capital Fund Limited, or ASCF, on Thursday, citing concerns that disclosure documents provided to retail investors may be defective. Here are some details: The Australian Securities and Investments Commission said the order prevents ASCF from offering, issuing, selling or transferring interests in the ASCF Premium Capital Fund, ASCF Select Income Fund and ASCF High Yield Fund. ASIC said it was concerned the product disclosure statement, or PDS, for the funds failed to adequately disclose information about the funds' loan portfolio and diversification metrics and that some information was not presented in a clear, concise and effective manner. The regulator also said the PDS may contain a misleading statement and omit information regarding the cost of disposing of an investment in the funds. "Firms must ensure their disclosures to investors are transparent and support informed decision making, including to help investors understand the strategies and risks of their products", ASIC Commissioner Simone Constant said. ASIC said it would consider making the orders permanent if the concerns were not addressed in a timely manner.

item.title: Award-winning Kashmiri filmmaker Arfat Sheikh detained by US immigration authorities
item.description: An award-winning filmmaker whose work has explored conflict in his native Kashmir has been detained by US immigration officials after legally coming to the United States to study and later claiming asylum, his family and friends said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: An award-winning filmmaker whose work has explored conflict in his native Kashmir has been detained by US immigration officials after legally coming to the United States to study and later claiming asylum, his family and friends said on Wednesday. The Department of Homeland Security separately confirmed on Wednesday that Arfat Sheikh was arrested on September 24. The department said that Sheikh "legally entered the US on a temporary basis and illegally overstayed his lawful admittance." A pending application does not confer legal status in the US, DHS said, adding he will receive due process. Sheikh was detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement, part of DHS, coming off a plane from California at Washington Dulles International Airport, according to a statement from relatives and friends campaigning for his release from detention. Sheikh, who lived in Alexandria, Virginia, entered the US in 2019 on a student visa to pursue graduate studies in film at Georgia State University and filed for asylum in 2020, according to the statement. It did not describe the grounds for his asylum claim. The statement said he had a pending immigration application and was authorized to work and live in the US. President Donald Trump's administration [USN:S0N41Z026 TEXT:"said in August"] it was working "to identify and revoke the non-immigrant visas of foreigners who have come to the US claiming to be short-term visitors, but then file for asylum to stay here permanently." Trump has pursued an [USN:L4N44L066 TEXT:"immigration crackdown"] and [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"deportation drive"] that he says aims to improve domestic security. Rights advocates say the crackdown has violated due process and free speech rights and has created an unsafe environment, particularly for ethnic minorities, who have raised concerns about [USN:L4N3ZU0AN TEXT:"racial profiling"]. Sheikh's first feature film, 2024's " Saffron Kingdom, " won Best Feature Film at the Chicago Filmmakers Awards, the LA Film and Documentary Awards, the Melbourne Independent Film Festival and the Wake Forest Film Festival. Sheikh, who hails from India-administered Kashmir, won the Emerging Filmmaker Activist Award at the Teaneck International Film Festival. The film explored conflict in Kashmir through the journey of a family from Srinagar in India-administered Kashmir in the 1990s to Atlanta in 2019. Muslim-majority Kashmir [USN:FWN3R83BQ TEXT:"is claimed in full"] by both Hindu-majority India and Islamic Pakistan, which each control only part of it and have fought wars over it. India revoked Kashmir's [USN:L1N3R108K TEXT:"constitutional autonomy"] in August 2019.

item.title: テニス＝坂本が2回戦進出、島袋は初戦敗退 マスターズ上海
item.description: ［７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［７日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのマスターズ上海大会は７日、中国の上海でシングルス１回戦を行い、予選から勝ち上がった坂本怜はマルコ・トルンヘリティ（アルゼンチン）を下し、２回戦に進出した。

坂本は第１セットを６─３で先取すると、第２セットも７─５で制してストレート勝ち。２回戦では、第２３シードでロシア出身のアンドレイ・ルブレフと対戦する。

主催者推薦で出場した島袋将はミオミル・ケツマノビッチ（セルビア）と対戦し、２─６、４─６のストレート負けを喫した。

そのほか、マテオ・ベレッティーニ（イタリア）、ヤニック・ハンフマン（ドイツ）、トマーシュ・マハツ（チェコ）、カンタン・アリス（フランス）らが初戦を突破した。

item.title: Corte de gastos é solução temporária para problema fiscal, diz cotado para assumir Fazenda sob Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: O economista Marcelo Kayath, um dos cotados para assumir o Ministério da Fazenda em um eventual governo Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), defendeu nesta quarta-feira que o problema fiscal do Brasil não vai ser resolvido apenas com corte de gastos e afirmou que essa "parada de arrumação" é algo temporário para o país voltar a crescer.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O economista Marcelo Kayath, um dos cotados para assumir o Ministério da Fazenda em um eventual governo Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), defendeu nesta quarta-feira que o problema fiscal do Brasil não vai ser resolvido apenas com corte de gastos e afirmou que essa "parada de arrumação" é algo temporário para o país voltar a crescer. "O problema do Brasil só vai ser resolvido com o crescimento. O problema fiscal do Brasil não vai ser resolvido com corte de gasto", disse Kayath em entrevista à CNN Brasil. "Corte de gasto, parada de arrumação... é uma coisa temporária pra gente ajustar as contas e dar as condições para o Banco Central cair (sic) os juros e a partir daí a gente arrumou de novo o carro, a gente volta a acelerar", acrescentou. Kayath destacou que essa ação poderá levar daqui a um a três anos o país, dependendo das condições, a começar a crescer de 3% a 4%. "Aí sim vamos ter solução mais permanente para nosso problema fiscal", frisou. Na entrevista, o economista e ex-diretor do Credit Suisse ressaltou ainda que só cortar não vai resolver o problema. Ao dizer que é algo temporário, ele fez uma analogia com ir ao dentista, afirmando que ninguém gosta, é chato, mas depois vai trazer prosperidade, oportunidade, emprego e renda. Kayath não deu detalhes de como seria esse ajuste nas contas e até se haveria uma espécie de PEC da transição com propostas para melhoria dos gastos públicos. O economista disse que as medidas têm que ser cirúrgicas e fez questão de afirmar em vários momentos da entrevista que é necessário preservar os programas sociais, que não podem ser afetados, "essa é uma premissa básica". "Em um país desigual como o Brasil, a gente não pode partir e começar um ajuste com os mais pobres e mais necessitados que têm que sofrer primeiro", disse. Após Flávio Bolsonaro ter surpreendido e ficado à frente na votação do primeiro turno, a campanha à reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) começa a explorar que uma eventual vitória do adversário poderia levar ao fim de programas sociais como Bolsa Família, entre outros. O candidato do PL nega. Questionado se assumirá a Fazenda em uma vitória de Flávio no segundo turno, Kayath afirmou que nunca conversou com o candidato sobre o tema. "Nunca conversei com o candidato Flávio Bolsonaro sobre cargos, nunca tivemos essa conversa e sinceramente o momento não é de falar em cargos... vamos esperar a eleição passar, ver como a eleição termina, como se elegeu e com qual maioria", ponderou.

item.title: サッカー＝アーセナル、アルテタ監督と2030年まで契約延長
item.description: ［７日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［７日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ王者アーセナルは７日、ミケル・アルテタ監督（４４）との契約を２０３０年６月まで延長したと発表した。

アルテタ監督は２０１９年、低迷していたチームの指揮官に就任。長期的な再建を進め、３季連続でリーグ２位となった後、昨季はクラブを２２年ぶりのプレミアリーグ優勝に導いた。欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）でも決勝に進出したが、パリ・サンジェルマン（フランス）にＰＫ戦で敗れた。

声明で「自分の将来をこのクラブに託し、アーセナルのために最高のものを求める素晴らしい人たちと仕事を続けられるのは光栄。このクラブは特別だ。われわれの旅がこれからも共に続くことを大変光栄に思う」と述べた。

選手としてはアーセナルで５年間プレーし、１６年に現役を引退。その後マンチェスター・シティーでジョゼップ・グアルディオラ監督のアシスタントコーチを務めた。

これまでアーセナルで公式戦３６１試合を指揮し、勝率６２．０５％は歴代監督（専任）で最高となっている。

item.title: Rate hike fears weigh on UK housing market, RICS says
item.description: The prospect of higher interest rates weighted on Britain's housing market last month, with downward pressure on house prices increasing for the first time in four months, the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The prospect of higher interest rates weighted on Britain's housing market last month, with downward pressure on house prices increasing for the first time in four months, the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors said on Thursday. RICS said its house price balance fell to -32 last month from a five-month high of -28 in August, a bigger decline than expected in a Reuters poll of economists, while the number of new properties coming onto the market rose for the first time since the middle of last year. "A renewed rise in interest rate expectations has created a fresh headwind for the housing market, with buyers becoming a little more cautious and sales activity losing some momentum," RICS Head of Market Research Tarrant Parsons said. RICS members expect property prices to fall further over the next three months but to be stable over a 12-month horizon London has the most negative price balance while Scotland and Northern Ireland reported rising prices Financial markets expect the BoE to raise rates in November, and three more times in 2027, though forecasts earlier this year for a string of rate rises proved premature RICS' measure of new buyer enquiries weakened for the first time since March, though it remains well above the low hit just after the outbreak of the US-Iran war Rising demand from tenants and fewer properties from landlords has pushed the net balance for rents above its average in the first half of the year, though it is lower than in August Mortgage lender [USN:L8N45T07N TEXT:"Lloyds"] reported unchanged house prices in September while [USN:L8N45N097 TEXT:"Nationwide"] reported a small unexpected drop Britain's Office for National Statistics reported a 3.8% annual rise in rents for private-sector housing in August and a 1.4% rise in house prices in the 12 months to July

item.title: REEDIÇÃO Samsung estima salto de quase 9 vezes no lucro do 3º tri puxado por IA
item.description: A Samsung Electronics projetou nesta quinta-feira-feira (horário local) um aumento de quase nove vezes no lucro operacional do terceiro trimestre sobre um ano antes, superando estimativas de analistas do setor e impulsionada pela alta demanda por chips de memória usados em aplicações de inteligência artificial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) projetou nesta quinta-feira-feira (horário local) um aumento de quase nove vezes no lucro operacional do terceiro trimestre sobre um ano antes, superando estimativas de analistas do setor e impulsionada pela alta demanda por chips de memória usados em aplicações de inteligência artificial. A maior fabricante mundial de microprocessadores de memória estimou lucro operacional de 107,4 trilhões de wons (US$80,17 bilhões) para o período de julho a setembro, em comparação com uma estimativa da LSEG SmartEstimate de 106,1 trilhões de wons. O quarto trimestre consecutivo de lucro operacional recorde da Samsung, acima dos 12,17 trilhões de wons registrados no ano anterior, ressalta como a crescente demanda por infraestrutura de IA superou o crescimento da oferta de chips de memória, uma disparidade que deve persistir até 2027. Os preços dispararam devido à escassez de chips DRAM e NAND convencionais, bem como à crescente demanda por memória de alta largura de banda (HBM), essencial para o processamento de grandes quantidades de dados para aplicações de IA. A receita do terceiro trimestre da Samsung deve mostrar um salto de 127%, para 195 trilhões de wons, segundo a previsão da companhia. A empresa deve divulgar resultados detalhados, incluindo um desdobramento dos lucros por divisão de negócios, ainda neste mês. (Por Joyce Lee e Heekyong Yang)

item.title: 米中間選挙、激戦区共和党候補の「トランプ離れ」鮮明に 支持率低下で
item.description:
Nathan Layne David Morgan
[７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nathan Layne　David Morgan

[７日 ロイター] - １１月３日の米中間選挙が迫る中で、ロイターが連邦議会上下両院の激戦選挙区・州に出馬している与党共和党候補を調査したところ、激戦が続く６２の選挙のうち４１の選挙では候補者がトランプ大統領との距離を取る姿勢を示していることが分かった。議会多数派維持を目指す共和党にとって、支持率低迷が続くトランプ氏が「重荷」となっている実態が浮き彫りになった。

調査は投票行動や公の発言、選挙運動資料などを分析。その結果、多くの候補者はトランプ氏の政策全体を否定するのではなく、個別政策で異なる立場を示すことで無党派層への支持拡大を図りつつ、トランプ氏との正面衝突を避けていることがうかがえた。

政策面での相違は６２の選挙うち２３の選挙で確認された。このうち１２の選挙ではイラン情勢への対応が争点となり、苦戦が予想される共和党候補がトランプ氏の戦争権限を制限する法案に賛成したり、戦闘終結を求めたりしていた。

データセンター開発も対立点の１つ。ロイターは激戦の候補３人が、開発加速を支持するトランプ氏に対し、事業を批判または抑制しようとしていることを確認した。

トランプ氏は過去１０年間で共和党を自身の色彩が強い政党へと変貌させ、異論を唱えた議員や候補者に対して予備選での対立候補支援や個人攻撃などで圧力をかけてきた。それだけに今回の動きは注目を集めている。

ロイター／イプソスの最新世論調査では、トランプ氏の支持率は過去最低の３２％にとどまった。一方、中間選挙に向けた支持政党では登録有権者の４４％が民主党、３７％が共和党を支持。無党派層では民主党が３７％、共和党が２１％だった。

そうした情勢を受け、トランプ氏との関係を目立たなくする動きも広がっている。１２人の候補者は党候補指名獲得後を中心に、選挙運動用ウェブサイトからトランプ氏の名前や写真、推薦表明への言及を削除した。またトランプ氏の集会への参加を見送ったり、自身の応援に来てほしいかどうかについて明言を避けたりする候補者もいる。

ただトランプ氏への直接批判は少数にとどまった。熱心な支持層を抱えるトランプ氏に公然と反旗を翻すことの政治的リスクの大きさを反映している。

選挙前に不人気な大統領と距離を置くのは珍しいことではなく、民主党も２０１４年と２２年の選挙で同様の戦術を取った。

共和党系の戦略担当者ロン・ボンジャン氏は「候補者たちは有権者の意識を反映している。有権者がトランプ氏を支持していなければ、候補者は違いを示す必要がある」と語った。複数の選対関係者もロイターに、無党派層の支持獲得のためにはトランプ氏との関係を薄める必要があると非公式の形では認めた。

中西部ネブラスカ州で無所属候補ダン・オズボーン氏と激しく争う共和党のピート・リケッツ上院議員は、ロイターが確認した「１つの政策でのみトランプ氏と異なる立場を取る１１人」の１人だ。リケッツ氏は牛肉輸入拡大を目指すトランプ氏の計画を批判する一方、今週はトランプ氏のネブラスカ州での集会に参加して「トランプ大統領、私はワシントンであなたのために戦ってきた」と訴えた。

同じ中西部アイオワ州選出の共和党下院議員マリアネット・ミラー・ミークス氏も、政権との相違を示す場面が増えている。牛肉輸入政策を批判したほか、以前は反対していたイランに関する大統領権限制限法案に賛成票を投じた。

item.title: Rússia diz que morte de funcionária do instituto de pesquisa sobre a peste não representa risco de epidemia
item.description: O órgão regulador da saúde da Rússia afirmou nesta quarta-feira que não há risco de surto de epidemia na Sibéria após a morte de uma funcionária de um instituto especializado em peste na região, enquanto a Organização Mundial da Saúde pressionava Moscou por mais informações sobre a causa da morte.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Osborn, Jennifer Rigby
item.content:encoded: O órgão regulador da saúde da Rússia afirmou nesta quarta-feira que não há risco de surto de epidemia na Sibéria após a morte de uma funcionária de um instituto especializado em peste na região, enquanto a Organização Mundial da Saúde pressionava Moscou por mais informações sobre a causa da morte. Autoridades russas afirmam que a funcionária do laboratório, de 28 anos, morreu na última sexta-feira de pneumonia de origem ainda não determinada, em um caso que gerou preocupação internacional, inclusive por parte do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump. Cerca de 200 pessoas foram inicialmente colocadas em quarentena. Questionado na quarta-feira se a morte teria sido causada por uma arma biológica, Trump disse aos repórteres: “Bem, não achamos que seja o caso. Vamos descobrir em breve, mas não achamos que seja.” Ele disse que a Rússia não está se pronunciando muito sobre a situação, mas “eles afirmam que têm tudo sob controle”, acrescentando que havia marcado uma ligação com o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin. “Eles estão compartilhando (informações) um pouco com nosso pessoal. Esperamos que compartilhem muito mais com nosso pessoal”, disse Trump, falando no Salão Oval. Autoridades globais de saúde — assim como a mídia mundial — têm estado particularmente atentas a casos de pneumonia de causa indeterminada desde a pandemia da Covid-19, que começou com um surto de doença respiratória fatal de rápida disseminação na China. No entanto, muitas vezes não é possível determinar a causa de casos individuais de pneumonia. A diretora do Centro de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças dos EUA, Erica Schwartz, disse em um evento que a agência estava preparada para monitorar e examinar viajantes, embora o risco para os EUA fosse extremamente baixo. A OMS inicialmente afirmou que estimava o risco do caso na Rússia para a população como baixo, com base no que havia sido divulgado, mas declarou em uma coletiva de imprensa nesta quarta-feira que não poderia fazer uma avaliação de risco mais completa devido à insuficiência de informações por parte das autoridades russas. A Rospotrebnadzor, órgão de fiscalização sanitária da Rússia, informou nesta quarta-feira que estava encerrando as medidas de precaução que havia adotado após concluir que não havia risco de epidemia e que havia compartilhado suas informações mais recentes com a OMS. Nenhum caso de peste foi detectado entre as pessoas que entraram em contato com a trabalhadora falecida, Darya Shipilova, informou o órgão, e 90% das pessoas colocadas em quarentena foram liberadas após quase 5.000 exames laboratoriais não terem detectado nenhum patógeno perigoso. A agência afirmou que Shipilova havia sido vacinada e, portanto, estava “imune às infecções perigosas com as quais trabalhava”. No entanto, não informou o que causou a pneumonia que a levou à morte nem como ela adoeceu. OMS SOLICITA MAIS INFORMAÇÕES Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, diretor-geral da OMS em Genebra, afirmou nesta quarta-feira que sua organização precisava de mais informações da Rússia para entender o que havia acontecido. “Gostaríamos de obter mais informações para entender quais exames laboratoriais foram realizados, quais patógenos foram avaliados e, se essa pessoa não morreu de peste, então como ela morreu?”, disse Maria Van Kerkhove, diretora do Departamento de Gestão de Epidemias e Pandemias da OMS, em uma coletiva de imprensa virtual. Tedros disse que a OMS havia oferecido assistência à Rússia e também reiterou o pedido para que a Rússia verifique as notícias da mídia sobre uma segunda pessoa com pneumonia de causa indeterminada. KREMLIN CRITICA “INFORMAÇÕES FALSAS” NA MÍDIA O Kremlin afirmou que a Rússia havia informado adequadamente a OMS sobre o incidente, de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos. Quando questionado sobre o pedido da OMS para que se pronunciasse sobre as notícias de que uma segunda pessoa na Sibéria teria adoecido, o porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, pediu cautela ao usar as reportagens da mídia como referência para o que estava acontecendo. “Há uma grande cobertura da mídia, e a grande maioria do que a mídia está divulgando sobre essa situação é informação falsa”, disse Peskov. Ele aconselhou a mídia e outras partes interessadas a se basearem nas informações fornecidas pela Rospotrebnadzor, órgão regulador de saúde da Rússia. O órgão não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário da Reuters nesta quarta-feira sobre as perguntas da OMS. CAUSA EXATA DA MORTE AINDA É DESCONHECIDA Alguns veículos de comunicação ocidentais noticiaram — citando “mídia russa” não identificada — que uma segunda pessoa na Sibéria havia morrido, alegando que a morte teria sido causada pela peste. A Reuters não conseguiu encontrar nenhuma notícia desse tipo na mídia russa nem qualquer evidência de que uma segunda pessoa na Sibéria tivesse morrido, embora alguns blogueiros nas redes sociais estivessem fazendo — sem evidências — tais afirmações. Após a coletiva de imprensa, a OMS enviou à Reuters um link para uma matéria sobre um possível segundo caso publicada pela organização de mídia russa starhit.ru, um site de fofocas sobre celebridades, e uma reportagem de acompanhamento do jornal britânico Daily Mail. Tedros disse que era importante ser transparente com base nas lições aprendidas com a Covid, acrescentando: “Na verdade, não temos qualquer mandato para verificar se essa mídia é confiável ou não.” A Rússia não respondeu formalmente às notícias sobre a morte de uma segunda pessoa, disse Tedros, acrescentando que havia ouvido apenas informalmente que a Rússia havia negado essas notícias. O apelo de Tedros por mais informações ecoou o do secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, que também afirmou que Moscou precisa compartilhar mais informações sobre o incidente. A pneumonia, uma infecção pulmonar, pode ter diversas causas, incluindo a peste, bem como outras infecções bacterianas ou doenças respiratórias virais, como a gripe ou a Covid-19.

item.title: UK labour market shows more signs recovery in September, KPMG/REC survey shows
item.description: Britain's labour market showed more signs of recovering last month from its protracted slowdown, with permanent staff placements rising at the fastest pace in four years, a survey of recruitment firms showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's labour market showed more signs of recovering last month from its protracted slowdown, with permanent staff placements rising at the fastest pace in four years, a survey of recruitment firms showed on Thursday. The survey from accountants KPMG and the Recruitment and Employment Confederation trade body added to signs of resilience in the British economy, which grew by more than expected during the first of the year. "For the second month in a row we are seeing the jobs market starting to flicker back to life, with businesses increasing their hiring across both permanent and temporary roles," said Jon Holt, KPMG group chief executive. Here are the key findings from the REC/KPMG Report on Jobs: • The index of permanent placements rose to 50.9 from 50.5 in August, the highest reading since September 2022, with readings above 50 denoting growth • Permanent starting salaries increased but at a slower pace than in August — something that may offer tentative reassurance to Bank of England officials who are trying to gauge the extent of domestic inflation pressure • Demand for staff contracted but at the weakest pace since August 2024, the survey showed • Recruiters reported the highest demand for IT and computing, and engineering jobs, chiming with official economic growth data that point to a AI-related upswing in activity • Retail and hospitality sectors showed the sharpest falls in demand • The Report on Jobs is viewed as a leading indicator of Britain's labour market • Some BoE interest rate-setters had thought a cooling labour market will help to prevent high inflation becoming entrenched as energy prices rise, stoked by the US-Iran war

item.title: 韓国、国内港でロシア向け燃料積み込まれたとのウクライナ報道を否定
item.description: [ソウル ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ７日 ロイター] - 韓国大統領府は７日、ロシアが韓国の港から石油製品を輸入したとするウクライナの報道を否定し、その非難は不適切だと述べた。

ウクライナの制裁担当最高責任者は６日、ロシアの石油精製所へのドローン攻撃で引き起こされた燃料危機の影響がこうした韓国からの輸入で緩和されたと述べた。

英紙ガーディアンは先に、港湾記録や船舶追跡データをもとに、英国や欧州連合（ＥＵ）の制裁対象となっている船舶を含む７隻のタンカーに、韓国の港で燃料が積み込まれていたと報じた。

韓国大統領府は、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻以来、韓国が「国際社会と緊密に連携し、ロシアに対する制裁および輸出管理を一貫して実施してきた」と表明した。

さらに、韓国当局は事実関係を精査し、輸出管理上の問題がないか確認しており、問題が確認されれば必要な措置を講じるとした。

ウクライナと韓国の関係は、先月にゼレンスキー大統領が北朝鮮兵の捕虜２人の韓国への移送を公表したことをきっかけに緊張状態にある。韓国政府は、この移送は秘密裏に行われるはずだったと説明した。

ウクライナ外務省の報道官は７日、記者団に対し、この対立は「機密保持に関する合意の解釈の違い」に起因しているとし、問題解決に向けて非公開の外交ルートを通じて精力的な取り組みが進められていると述べた。

item.title: Oil price volatility tops list of earnings risks for Japan firms: Reuters poll
item.description: Volatility in the global crude oil market tops the list of major risks for Japanese companies, followed by foreign exchange fluctuations and rising interest rates, a Reuters survey showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Kiyoshi Takenaka
item.content:encoded: Volatility in the global crude oil market tops the list of major risks for Japanese companies, followed by foreign exchange fluctuations and rising interest rates, a Reuters survey showed on Thursday. The US-Israeli war on Iran, which began on February 28, has constrained crude oil supply, sent energy costs higher and driven up prices of a wide range of oil-derived products, including auto parts and construction materials. In 2025, resource-poor Japan imported 94% of its crude oil from the Middle East. About 37% of the survey's respondents chose crude market volatility as the top risk to their earnings prospects, while 21% picked foreign exchange moves and 19% selected higher interest rates. "Rising energy costs driven by the crude oil market and investment cutbacks during a period of rising interest rates that are cooling domestic demand for cement - those are the risk factors," a manager at a company in the ceramics sector wrote in the survey. The ceramics sector includes manufacturers of glass, cement and ceramic products. Last month, the Bank of Japan raised interest rates to a 31-year high, with Governor Kazuo Ueda signalling that the central bank has entered a new phase focused on preventing inflation from overshooting its target, which opened the door to further rate hikes. "Real estate demand is bound to slow down because of higher rates," a manager at a real estate firm said. Multiple companies participating in the survey also cited uncertainties about the sustainability of artificial intelligence-related investment - which has spurred demand for advanced microchips and prompted a rapid buildup of data centres - as a potential earnings risk. "It is vitally important for corporate management to ascertain how much longer an increase in demand brought about by AI investment lasts and when such demand starts turning lower," a respondent at a machinery maker said. Last month, the Mitsubishi Research Institute said AI investment, centred on data centres, is projected to expand over the medium to long term, but the pace of investment may be adjusted due to factors like power constraints, stricter regulations and rising costs. The poll was conducted by Nikkei Research for Reuters from September 18 to October 2. Nikkei Research contacted 508 companies, of which 215 responded on the condition of anonymity. On financial performance, 32% of respondents see net earnings for the first half of the current business year beating their own forecasts, while 22% believe they are missing their original outlook. And 46% expect half-year results to be in line with initial projections. A fiscal year starts in April for most major Japanese companies. Earnings announcements for the April-to-September period are scheduled for later this month and into November. For the second half of the fiscal year, more companies are bearish than bullish about their financial outlooks. About 22% of respondents expect net earnings to fall short of their initial forecasts, 20% expect October-to-March earnings to exceed their estimates and 58% say their initial outlook remains intact, the survey showed.

item.title: UK, Germany to launch new partnership to counter sabotage, cyberattacks
item.description: Britain and Germany will launch a joint partnership to counter sabotage and cyberattacks as Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Chancellor Friedrich Merz meet in Berlin on Thursday, shortly after both leaders warned of the hybrid threat from Russia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain and Germany will launch a joint partnership to counter sabotage and cyberattacks as Prime Minister Andy Burnham and Chancellor Friedrich Merz meet in Berlin on Thursday, shortly after both leaders warned of the hybrid threat from Russia. New joint partnership will involve sharing information, and coordinating action to monitor, deter and disrupt threats to critical infrastructure or via cyber attacks and sabotage, Downing Street said UK says adversaries, "especially Russia", pose a hybrid threat in Europe and beyond; British ministers were last month due to [USN:L8N45H0EB TEXT:"brief defence companies"] and critical national infrastructure providers on the threat posed by Russia Germany's head of foreign intelligence on Monday [USN:L8N45R0HH TEXT:"warned that"] "the confrontation we are facing with Russia has taken on a new, more dangerous dimension" Last month, Germany said it had concluded [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Russia was responsible"] for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport in August

item.title: サムスン電子、第3四半期営業益は約9倍に ＡＩ需要が追い風
item.description: [ソウル ８日 ロイター] - メモリー半導体世界最大手の韓国サムスン電子は８日、第３・四半期の営業利益が前年同期の約９...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
サムスン電子、第3四半期営業益は約9倍に　ＡＩ需要が追い風 8:09 配信

サムスン電子のロゴ。2025年8月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic
