By Susan Heavey WASHINGTON, Oct 6 (Reuters) – The US Department of Homeland Security has proposed that international students pay at least $70,000 in training fees if they want to work in the country, according to a government notice posted online on Wednesday, part of the Trump administration’s wider crackdown on foreign visa holders.

Under the proposal, nonimmigrant students with F-1 visas would be required to pay $70,000 to a certified institution for on-the-job training, known as Optional Practical Training (OPT), and $30,000 for any additional work training.

DHS said the new rules were meant “to combat fraud, strengthen the integrity of the immigration system, and protect US workers.”

Show Full Article

Under the OPT system, foreign students can engage in work training for up to 20 hours per week while school is in session, as well as for a limited time after graduation, with an additional allowance for those with degrees in science, technology, engineering and mathematics. Those who enroll are currently expected to pay around $500.

“DHS is now setting a fee to ensure employers, students, and institutions are engaging in appropriate activities consistent with admission as an F-1 nonimmigrant,” the agency said.

Such training programs often serve as a bridge for students seeking work under H-1B visas, which the Trump administration has also targeted with increased fees.

For decades, the H-1B program has allowed young engineers and scientists from across the world, especially India and China, to turn years of study at US universities into high-paying jobs and a path to permanent US residency. Leading US tech companies have come to rely heavily on these workers to fill skilled positions.

When he was campaigning in 2024, President Donald Trump vowed he would make it easier for foreign students to remain in the country, suggesting they be automatically awarded a Green Card after graduation.

Like similar DHS proposals, the rule change is likely to be met with swift legal challenges.

“This proposed rule isn’t going to fare well in the courts, just as the 100k H-1B fee and other restrictionist policies have been struck down,” Doug Rand, director of the Talent Mobility Fund, which works to attract foreign STEM professionals, wrote on LinkedIn on Wednesday.

The proposal is subject to 30 days of public comment before it can be finalized.

DHS said it would wait 60 days after finalization before putting the rule into effect to allow schools, students and employers time to prepare.

(Reporting by Susan Heavey; Editing by Daniel Wallis)

item.title: ＦＲＢ9月利上げ理由で見解相違、債券市場混乱への備え要請も＝議事要旨
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が７日公表した９月１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ9月利上げ理由で見解相違、債券市場混乱への備え要請も＝議事要旨 3:26 配信

2025年9月17日、米国ワシントンD.C.で撮影。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno/File Photo

Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -  米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が７日公表した９月１５─１６日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）議事要旨によると、利上げの理由を巡って当局者の見解が分かれていた。一部の参加者はエネルギーなどの価格ショックの影響を抑えるために必要と判断した一方、よりタカ派的な参加者は、需要主導のインフレが生じつつあることへの備えとして必要と捉えていた。また、一部の当局者からは、債券市場の混乱に備え中央銀行として対応策を準備すべきだとの意見も示された。

ＦＲＢは９月会合で、フェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を０．２５％ポイント引き上げ、３．７５─４．００％とすると決定した。決定は全会一致だった。

ただ、その措置が主に予防的なものなのか、投資や支出を抑えるために金融政策を大幅に引き締める方向への転換なのかを巡っては、当局者の見解が一致しなかった。

議事要旨は「多くの参加者は、リスク管理の観点から政策金利の誘導目標レンジをより高めに推移させることが賢明だと強調した。これは、需要が予想以上に強まったり、供給面で新たな悪影響を伴うショックが起きたりすることで、インフレ率が目標を上回ったまま高止まりする事態への備えとなる」と記した。

一方、別の参加者は、９月に決定した政策金利の引き上げについて、最近のエネルギーなどの価格ショックが物価により広範な影響を及ぼすのを防ぐ上で重要と判断した。２人の参加者は、中立金利の推計値が従来より高いと考えており、それに合わせる措置として利上げを支持した。

また「複数の参加者は、現在の政策金利が景気抑制的ではないか、抑制的であってもその程度は小さいとの見方を示した」という。さらに、「大半の参加者は、年末までにＦＦ金利の誘導目標レンジを再び引き上げることが適切になる可能性が高いと判断した」とした。

＜バランスシート政策、市場ストレスに備える必要性＞

バランスシート政策についても議論が交わされた。議事要旨は「バランスシート政策に関して、少数の参加者は米国債市場が円滑に機能していると指摘しつつも、市場ストレスへの備えの重要性に言及した」としている。

これらの当局者は、ＦＲＢが米国債市場で占める存在感を抑えつつ、「市場機能不全が起きた場合に対処するためのＦＲＢの戦略、コミュニケーション、ツールを強化すること」を提案した。

金融政策の方向性の転換は、国債利回りの急上昇を伴い、住宅ローン金利などに顕著な上昇をもたらした。

ＦＲＢ当局者はこの利回り上昇について、堅調な景気見通しやハイテク投資の影響、そして地政学的懸念を要因として挙げてきた。ただ、相場変動の勢いの強さから、巨額の財政赤字とインフレ見通しへの継続的な懸念が存在する中での市場の状態について不安を抱く当局者も出てきている。

こうした懸念はＦＲＢのバランスシートに関わるものだ。過去２０年間、ＦＲＢは市場ストレスの大きな局面で債券買い入れを通じて対応してきた。例えば、新型コロナウイルス感染症の流行初期には国債と住宅ローン担保証券（ＭＢＳ）の大量購入を行い、その後、こうした操作を景気刺激策の形に移行させた。

＜バランスシートを巡る綱渡り＞

そうした買い入れはＦＲＢのバランスシートの規模を膨らませる。ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はバランスシート縮小を望んでおり、それを検証するためのタスクフォース（作業部会）を任命している。

マネタリーポリシー・アナリティクスのアナリスト、デレク・タン氏は、議事要旨のコメントについて「ＦＲＢの考え方が変わっていないことを市場とホワイトハウスに暗に示す、遠回しな表現のようだ。すなわち、政策波及が脅かされる場合にのみ介入するのであり、単に利回りが急上昇しているからというだけでは介入しない」との見方を示した。

タン氏はさらに、たとえＦＲＢが介入するとしても、動揺する市場に対する第一防衛線として、流動性を供給する常設レポ・オペレーションやディスカウント・ウィンドウ（連銀窓口貸出）といったツールを用いるだろうと述べた。注目すべきは、これら２つのツールが既に整備されており、市場のニーズが発生した際に対応できるよう、本質的に自動運転状態にあることだ。

一方、ＴＤセキュリティーズの米金利戦略責任者ゲナディ・ゴールドバーグ氏は、議事要旨のコメントは、準備預金水準を下支えするための米短期国債買い入れの技術的な管理に向けられたものと見ている。

同氏は「年末にかけて若干のストレスが見られる傾向にあることを踏まえると、これは今後数カ月の間に準備金管理買い入れ（ＲＭＰ）を再開することに関する議論なのかもしれない」と述べ、「ＦＲＢはすべてが円滑に機能することを確実にするため、年末までに控えめなペースでＲＭＰを再開する可能性があると考えている」と付け加えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 最終更新: 10/8(木) 6:10 ロイター

NEW YORK, Oct 7 : Elliott Investment Management and Siris are exploring a sale of Gigamon that could value the infrastructure software provider at more than $2 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. The firms have tapped investment bankers at Bank of America and Perella Weinberg Partners to advise Gigamon on the process, which is in its early stages, said the people, who requested anonymity because the deliberations are confidential. A sale process could attract interest from private equity firms as well as strategic buyers seeking to expand their capabilities in network monitoring, cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure management, the people said. Based in Santa Clara, California, Gigamon provides software that helps companies monitor network traffic and detect security threats. Founded in 2004, the company serves more than 4,000 customers globally, including banks, healthcare providers and government agencies, according to its website.

Gigamon generated more than $400 million in annual recurring revenue and around $170 million in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA), the sources said.  Gigamon, Siris, Elliott, and Bank of America declined to comment. Perella Weinberg did not respond to a request for comment. Elliott acquired Gigamon in 2017 in a take-private transaction, which valued the company at about $1.6 billion. Private equity firm Siris bought a minority stake in Gigamon in 2024. The potential sale comes as investors continue to show interest in software companies that provide critical infrastructure tools underpinning cloud computing, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence deployments.

item.title: ロシア研究所職員死亡「生物兵器原因ではない」、 情報共有を期待＝トランプ氏
item.description: [ワシントン ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　７日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は７日、ロシア東部シベリアのペスト研究所の職員が死亡した件について、生物兵器が原因ではないとの考えを示した。

トランプ氏は記者団に対し「ロシアは事態は管理下にあるとしている」と述べ、ロシアが多くの情報を共有すると期待していると語った。

ロシア衛生当局はこの日、ペスト研究所の職員が死亡した件を巡り、東部シベリア地域で流行が広がるリスクはないと説明。ただ、世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）はロシアに対し死因に関するさらなる情報の提供を求めている。

item.description: Oct 7 : The world's oldest-known terrestrial animal, an Aldabra giant tortoise named Jonathan and estimated to be about 194 years old, may owe his extraordinary longevity to a combination of genetic traits and an ability to keep key cellular systems functioning in a more youthful way, according to scientists.

A 194-year-old tortoise, world's oldest land animal, may hold clues to longer life

FAST

Oct 7 : The world's oldest-known terrestrial animal, an Aldabra giant tortoise named Jonathan and estimated to be about 194 years old, may owe his extraordinary longevity to a combination of genetic traits and an ability to keep key cellular systems functioning in a more youthful way, according to scientists.  Members of this species are known to live more than 100 years, but Jonathan has far exceeded that. Brought to the remote South Atlantic island of St Helena as a fully grown animal in 1882, likely from the Aldabra Atoll or the Granitic Seychelles, the tortoise now resides in a paddock at Plantation House, the governor's residence.  "Other Aldabra tortoises have been claimed to have lived as long as Jonathan, but he has the most documentary evidence supporting his age," said Benjamin Vaisvil, a researcher affiliated with the organization Kallel and co-lead author of the study published on Wednesday in the journal Science Advances. Scientists have studied Jonathan to explore the secrets of the animal's amazing longevity, sequencing his genome and analysing his epigenome — the chemical markers that control which genes switch on and off.

"We found changes in Jonathan's genome in pathways associated with longevity, like DNA repair, mitochondrial function, insulin regulation and telomere function," Vaisvil said.  Mitochondria are structures considered the powerhouse of a cell. Insulin is a hormone that helps regulate levels of blood sugar by letting it enter the body's cells for energy. Telomeres are protective caps at the ends of chromosomes, structures that carry genetic information inside cell nuclei.  Researchers compared Jonathan's epigenome with four other Aldabra tortoises, ranging from juveniles to older adults. While pretending to feed Jonathan, they waited until he began biting the air, then wedged his mouth open with a gloved hand and scraped under his tongue with a specialized kit. St Helena officials restrict blood draws to prevent infection risks. To explain the finding, Vaisvil compared the genome to a cookbook and the epigenome to handwritten notes in the margins. "As the cookbook ages, those notes become more difficult to read clearly. We can think of that as methylation entropy," Vaisvil said, referring to a metric for disorder in a certain biochemical process. Most of the notes in Jonathan's "cookbook" look very old. But in certain regions, stretches of DNA that act as switches controlling whether genes are turned on or off, Jonathan's methylation entropy was lower than that of every tortoise studied except a 5-year-old juvenile. These regions controlled genes that influence longevity.  The researchers identified 287 genes with variants unique to Jonathan, including some linked to tumour suppression and DNA repair. The tortoise also carries extra copies of a gene that encodes a protein that hunts down ageing and cancerous cells. 'GENTLE GIANT' When younger, Jonathan was known for mischievous antics including overturning chairs and lying on croquet balls, according to the tortoise's longtime veterinarian and study co-author Joe Hollins. Cataracts have since left him mostly blind. Hollins describes Jonathan today as "a gentle giant." Determining how long giant tortoises can live is challenging because reliable historical records are scarce and many outlive researchers. Record-keeping before the 20th century also was problematic. While a young tortoise's age can be estimated from growth rings on the plates that form the animal's shell, ascertaining the age of adults is more difficult.  The new study involved only one exceptionally old tortoise, making it hard to determine whether the traits identified are unique to Jonathan or common among long-lived tortoises.  "We cannot say for certain that what we found is the reason for his longevity," Vaisvil said. Environmental factors also may have contributed. Jonathan lives on a tropical island, with an optimal diet carefully managed by trained veterinarians. The research findings broadly match patterns documented in studies of exceptionally long-lived people, suggesting that some mechanisms of aging may be shared across species.  Vaisvil noted that a recent study of a 117-year-old woman found unusually efficient mitochondrial function, echoing findings in some of Jonathan's regions. VORACIOUS APPETITE Despite his age, Jonathan retains a voracious appetite, Hollins said, lifting his head and stretching out his long neck when the veterinarian calls out his name.  "I know he knows me, knows my voice and my handling, and I also know it isn't love on his part but a recognition of the arrival of a feast," Hollins said. "And yet I, of course, don't mind. I have a huge affection for him."  "He is a remarkable symbol. Icon, I know, is an overused word, but Guinness World Records has just given him 'icon' status this year," Hollins said.  Beloved by island residents, Jonathan has lived through world wars and the rise and fall of empires.  "He is symbolic of resilience, longevity, endurance, a persistent presence throughout huge historic events," Hollins said.

Source: Reuters

Oct 7 : Anthropic on Wednesday launched Claude Haiku 5.5, the third model in its Claude 5.5 family in the past month, expanding its artificial intelligence lineup ahead of a planned IPO. Here are some details: • Haiku 5.5 is built for tasks such as classification, summarization and extraction, including live support, voice agents and in-app assistants. It costs 75 per cent less than its predecessor, Haiku 4.5. • The new model is priced at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens for prompts under 100,000 tokens, rising to $0.50 and $2.50, respectively, for longer prompts. • The company said it is Anthropic's first Haiku with built-in safeguards for a narrow set of high-risk cybersecurity requests, and added that most everyday tasks would not be impacted.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Fed policymakers divided over rate-hike logic in September, minutes show
item.description: Federal Reserve policymakers were divided last month over the rationale for raising interest rates, with "some participants" seeing a hike as needed to keep the impact of energy and other price shocks at bay, but a more hawkish core viewing it as necessary to guard against emerging demand-driven inflation.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve policymakers were divided last month over the rationale for raising interest rates, with "some participants" seeing a hike as needed to keep the impact of energy and other price shocks at bay, but a more hawkish core viewing it as necessary to guard against emerging demand-driven inflation. The competing arguments were outlined in the minutes of the US central bank's September 15-16 meeting, at which the Fed voted unanimously to raise the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"policy rate"] by a quarter of a percentage point even as officials disagreed about whether the move was largely precautionary or represented a shift towards significantly tighter monetary policy meant to curb investment and spending. The split, and the varying interpretations of where the economy stands right now, set up a likely vigorous debate at the October 27-28 policy meeting over whether inflation has taken on a broader, demand-driven dimension that warrants further Fed action now. The alternative would be to wait on further rate hikes to see if incoming data shows energy, tariff and other price shocks receding and inflation heading back to the central bank's 2% target. "Many participants emphasized that a higher path for the target range would be prudent on risk-management grounds, providing insurance against inflation remaining persistently above target due to stronger-than-expected demand or further adverse supply shocks," said the minutes of the session, which were released on Wednesday. Others, meanwhile, saw the "higher policy rate" approved in September as important to prevent recent energy and other shocks from having a broader influence on prices, while "a couple" framed their support for the hike as matching what they saw as a higher estimated neutral rate of interest. "Several participants stated that they viewed the current policy rate as not restrictive or only mildly restrictive," the minutes stated. "Most participants assessed that another increase in the target range for the federal funds rate would likely be appropriate by year end." Investors, who had expected sequential rate hikes in the days following the September meeting, have since pared back their bets and now see the Fed keeping its policy rate in the 3.75%-4.00% range at its meeting later this month, just ahead of midterm congressional elections, but hiking again at the December 8-9 gathering. Following the release of [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"weaker-than-expected jobs"] and [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation data"], Fed officials' recent comments added weight to the sense that policymakers would now allow some time for new data to show whether underlying inflation was coming down from current levels that are more than a percentage point above the Fed's target, or proving more persistent. But the arguments outlined at the September meeting have persisted, with some policymakers also saying they feel more and faster rate hikes are needed, potentially setting up a divided outcome and multiple dissents at the meeting later this month.

item.title: CDC sees low plague risk, monitors Siberia arrivals after worker death, director says
item.description: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director Erica Schwartz said on Wednesday the risk to the US from an unconfirmed pneumonic plague case in Siberia was extremely low, but the agency was prepared to monitor and screen travelers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention Director Erica Schwartz said on Wednesday the risk to the US from an unconfirmed pneumonic plague case in Siberia was extremely low, but the agency was prepared to monitor and screen travelers. "We are working with Department of Homeland Security, working (with) Department of State, Department of War, and other agencies within the government to make sure that we know exactly if anyone from that area comes into the United States," Schwartz said at the Wall Street Journal's The Future of Health event in Washington. The CDC has a port health station at the John F. Kennedy International Airport that can conduct surveillance and screening for travelers from the region entering the United States, she added. The US Department of Health and Human Services did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether the agency planned to set up screening at JFK. An HHS spokesman said there are about 200 individuals per year from the Siberian region who travel to the United States. Direct flights between Russia and the United States have been suspended since the start of the Ukraine war in 2022. Russia's health regulator said there were [USN:SPN43X00F TEXT:"no risks"] of an epidemic breaking out in Siberia after a plague institute worker there died from pneumonia of an as-yet unestablished origin, in a case that has prompted international concern. "What we're doing from a whole of government standpoint is we're making sure that we understand exactly what that threat is," Schwartz said. "We are very confident that the threat to the United States is extremely low." US President Donald Trump also [USN:S0N42W01I TEXT:"told reporters"] he does not think the death is from a bioweapon. (This story has been corrected to change the attribution to HHS from Schwartz and to say 200 individuals per year, not 200 flights, in paragraph 5.)

Oct 7 : Florida asked a state judge on Wednesday to order changes to Instagram and Facebook to better protect young users, pressing ahead with a lawsuit accusing parent Meta Platforms of harming teens after most states resolved similar claims through a sweeping settlement. In a filing in a Pasco County court, Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier asked for a temporary injunction forcing Meta to identify and remove users in the state under the age of 14 from those platforms, limit teens there to two hours a day across all apps and turn off features like autoplay and infinite scroll for them. The filing asked that the changes be implemented immediately and be in place while the lawsuit moves forward. A Meta spokesperson in a statement said after the company's settlement with nearly every other state, Florida should focus on getting other platforms to take action.

"The attorney general should be using taxpayer resources to get YouTube and TikTok to empower parents and protect teens in Florida. We regret that he has chosen instead to pursue a meritless preliminary injunction years into the litigation," the spokesperson said. Florida's lawsuit against Meta, which accuses the company of knowingly engineering its platforms to be addictive for young users and misleading consumers about its safety, was one of dozens of similar lawsuits filed by states across the country. In August, Meta reached settlements with 48 of the other states and Washington, DC, agreeing to pay up to $18 billion and make changes for teen users of its platforms. Meta has said it works hard to keep teens safe on its platforms, and the company denied wrongdoing in agreeing to settle. The total payout represents about three to four months of profit and about one month of revenue for Meta.  Uthmeier, a Republican, opted not to join the settlement and proceed with his lawsuit. Florida said in the filing that the settlement amounted to a “mere slap on the wrist, will be cynically viewed as the cost of doing business, and in any event will not prevent this kind of behavior going forward.” The changes Uthmeier's filing seeks are more stringent than those the company agreed to as part of that settlement, as they would cut off teens' access to messaging after their time limits are hit and bar the company from showing them advertisements. The changes Meta agreed to make as part of the settlement are an indication these changes are possible, Uthmeier's office argued.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Tropical Storm Isaias forecast to hit US Gulf coast as hurricane early Saturday
item.description: Tropical Storm Isaias formed in the Gulf of Mexico on Wednesday and is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane before slamming into the southern US coast early on Saturday, bringing heavy rains, storm surges, and possible tornadoes across several states, the National Hurricane Center said.
item.dc:creator: Brad Brooks, Nathan Crooks
item.content:encoded: Tropical Storm Isaias formed in the Gulf of Mexico on Wednesday and is forecast to strengthen into a hurricane before slamming into the southern US coast early on Saturday, bringing heavy rains, storm surges, and possible tornadoes across several states, the National Hurricane Center said. The storm is expected to pass through areas with significant [USN:L1N45T0JO TEXT:"offshore oil and gas production"], along with onshore refining facilities, which could pressure inventories and already-high prices at the pump. Michael Brennan, director of the NHC, said in a video briefing on Wednesday that Isaias could be a "major" hurricane — Category 3 or higher — when it makes landfall and could have "multiple, life-threatening impacts from storm surge, heavy rainfall flooding and hurricane force winds." Isaias would be the first hurricane of the season in the Atlantic, according to the NHC, and could tie the record for the latest first Atlantic hurricane with one that hit on October 8, 1905. The strong El Nino weather pattern this year has suppressed Atlantic hurricane development by increasing vertical wind shear, which disrupts the formation of strengthening tropical storms. About 11.2 million barrels of oil production could be lost across the Gulf through the duration of the storm, a marked increase from the 7.1 million barrels impacted by [USN:FWN42P0ED TEXT:"Tropical Storm "]Bertha in July, according to a model forecast from consulting firm Earth Science Associates. QUICK DEVELOPMENT, TORNADOES The NHC expects Isaias to develop into a hurricane by Thursday as it quickly picks up power over the warm Gulf waters before making landfall early on Saturday, most likely somewhere along the Mississippi, Alabama or Florida panhandle coast. The storm was located about 500 miles (805 km) south of the Louisiana coast early on Wednesday. Isaias could produce isolated rainfall amounts of 10 inches (25.4 cm) across parts of the Gulf Coast, stretching from Louisiana to the Florida Panhandle, the NHC said in its latest bulletin. Tornadoes are possible in the rainbands of Isaias across the Florida panhandle and Alabama from Friday evening through Saturday, with more tornadoes expected further inland as the storm moves north. The storm could also produce 3 inches or more of rain further inland, with the NHC warning that "flash and urban flooding, along with isolated river flooding, will be possible" across the Southeast. Isaias is expected to run into strong upper-level winds, known as vertical wind shear, in the final 24 hours before it reaches the northern Gulf Coast, which could weaken the storm. Still, the NHC says it is “looking more likely that Isaias will be a significant hurricane when it reaches the coast.” Florida Governor Ron DeSantis on Tuesday had already declared a state of emergency for portions of the state. Some officials across the region were urging residents to voluntarily evacuate. Florida US Senator Rick Scott wrote on social media that he had spoken with President Donald Trump about the storm, and that "the federal government is going to show up for Florida and make sure we have everything needed to prepare, respond, and recover." IMPACTS ON OIL, GAS The Marine Minerals Administration, which monitors offshore oil and gas operators in the Gulf of Mexico, said on Wednesday that personnel have been evacuated from eight production platforms and two non-dynamically positioned ahead of the storm. About 25% of current oil production in the Gulf, or 511,619 barrels of oil per day, has been shut in, the agency said, citing operator reports. Just over 350 million cubic feet per day of natural gas production has also been shut in, or about 16.4% of total output from the region. The companies with the most exposure to the storm include BP (BP.L) , Chevron (CVX.N) , ENI (ENI.MI) , Murphy Oil (MUR.N) and Shell (SHEL.L)

item.title: Liquidación de bonos Tesoro EEUU se modera, rendimientos bajan desde máximos
item.description: Los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron el miércoles, y los rendimientos cayeron desde sus máximos a medida que bajaban los precios del petróleo y una sólida subasta de deuda a 10 años tranquilizó a los inversores al demostrar que la demanda de deuda pública a largo plazo se mantiene intacta.
item.dc:creator: Gertrude Chavez-Dreyfuss
item.content:encoded: Los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos subieron el miércoles, y los rendimientos cayeron desde sus máximos a medida que bajaban los precios del petróleo y una sólida subasta de deuda a 10 años tranquilizó a los inversores al demostrar que la demanda de deuda pública a largo plazo se mantiene intacta. La deuda pública estadounidense había sufrido una renovada presión vendedora, lo que llevó a los retornos a 10 y 30 años a máximos de 24 años, al dispararse los precios del petróleo por sobre los 100 dólares. Esto reavivó los temores de que la inflación pudiera resultar más persistente de lo esperado. Analistas dijeron que la sólida venta de 39.000 millones de dólares en deuda a 10 años desencadenó una oleada de compras en todo el mercado de bonos del Tesoro. Algunos inversores temían una demanda débil, dado el persistente sentimiento bajista hacia la deuda a más largo plazo en los últimos meses. La caída de los precios del petróleo también contribuyó a que los rendimientos bajasen desde sus máximos, después de que la Agencia Internacional de la Energía acordase acelerar la liberación de reservas y dar prioridad al diésel, en un intento por frenar los precios récord del combustible. En las operaciones de la tarde, el rendimiento de los bonos referenciales a 10 años subía 1,3 puntos básicos, al 5,284%, tras tocar un pico de 24 años del 5,364%, mientras que el de las notas a 30 años también alcanzaba un máximo de 24 años y luego avanzaba 2,8 pb, al 5,669%. En el extremo más corto de la curva, el retorno de los papeles a dos años , que reflejan las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés, bajaba 2,3 pb al 4,768%. La deuda estadounidense también se vio afectada por las noticias de que SpaceX (SPCX.O) , la empresa de Elon Musk, estaba buscando una financiación de 40.000 millones de dólares para sufragar la compra de chips de Nvidia. Si SpaceX entra en el mercado de bonos con calificación de inversión, podría reavivar las preocupaciones de que los préstamos corporativos a gran escala estén compitiendo con los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo por el capital de los inversores, según analistas. Los responsables de la política monetaria de la Reserva Federal estuvieron divididos el mes pasado respecto de los motivos para subir las tasas de interés, mostraron las minutas de la última reunión del banco central.

item.title: 10代のチャットＧＰＴ利用、1日平均15分未満 オープンＡＩ報告書
item.description:
Anzar Mehraj Deepa Seetharaman
[７日 ロイター] - 米オープンＡＩは７日、１０代の若...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
10代のチャットＧＰＴ利用、1日平均15分未満　オープンＡＩ報告書 1:58 配信

2023年2月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

Anzar Mehraj　Deepa Seetharaman

[７日 ロイター] - 米オープンＡＩは７日、１０代の若者による人工知能（ＡＩ）利用状況に関する初の報告書を発表した。それによると、対話型ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」の１日当たりの平均利用時間は１５分未満にとどまり、３時間以上連続して利用するケースも２％未満だった。

また、長時間利用の防止に向けた「休憩リマインダー」機能が表示された対話では、ほぼ半数のユーザーが休憩を取るか、その後５分以内に利用を終了したという。

ＡＩプラットフォームが急速に普及し、若年層のメンタルヘルスや発達への影響を巡る懸念が高まる中、オープンＡＩは８月、１８歳以下向けの保護機能「チャットＧＰＴ・フォー・ティーンズ」を導入。利用者が１８歳未満と推定された場合や、１３─１７歳と自己申告した場合に適用され、自傷行為や暴力、摂食障害など高リスク分野の対話を制限するほか、保護者による管理機能を強化した。

一方、非営利団体「コモン・センス・メディア」は同日公表した報告書で、テスト用アカウントでは保護機能があっても、自殺や自傷行為、摂食障害に関する会話が行われた際、保護者への通知が遅れるか、全く送信されないケースが多かったと指摘した。

これに対しオープンＡＩの広報担当者は、同調査は若年層向け安全対策を「正確に反映していない」と反論。セキュリティーや規模を理由に、保護者アカウントと若者アカウントの連携や安全アラートの有効化に数時間かかる場合があると説明した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か 最終更新: 10/8(木) 1:58 ロイター

The order, which had been expected after Biman recently ordered 11 Boeing aircraft, includes four long-haul A350-900 and six medium-haul A231neo jets. item.title: EXCLUSIVE-サウジ、フライドバイ機刺傷事件で安全調査開始 刑事捜査とは別
item.description:
Allison Lampert Tim Hepher Steven Scheer Federico Maccioni
[７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Allison Lampert　Tim Hepher　Steven Scheer　Federico Maccioni

[７日 ロイター] - ９月３０日に発生したフライドバイＦＺ１０７３便の操縦室内刺傷事件を受け、サウジアラビアが航空事故調査に着手したことが分かった。関係者３人が明らかにした。アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）主導の刑事捜査とは別に、事件が航空安全にもたらす影響を専門家が精査する。

事故後に航空の安全確保を目的とした安全調査を実施するのは通例だが、フライドバイ機の事案のように、故意の行為が関与する場合には義務ではない。

これまで、サウジがこのような調査を実施するかどうかは不明だった。専門家によると、今回の調査は、責任追及ではなく安全確保のための勧告を目的とする国際協力体制が試される可能性がある。

関係者によると、サウジは海外の航空安全当局に対し、国際ルールに基づきＦＺ１０７３便の安全調査を実施すると通知した。この便は、副操縦士が機長をおので襲撃した際、サウジ領空内を飛行していた。

事故調査を担当するサウジの国家交通安全センター、サウジ政府および同国の規制当局のコメントは得られていない。

ＵＡＥは既に、この事件について別途刑事捜査を開始している。

搭乗していた１７２人のほぼ全員を自国民が占めたイスラエルは、サウジ主導の安全調査への参加を申し出たが、同国航空事故当局によると、現時点では招待を受けていない。

サウジとイスラエルは国交がない。ただ、専門家によると、事故率の大幅な低下に大きく貢献したとされる数十年来の事故防止協力体制は、政治的な一線を越えることが可能だという。

FAST

LIEGE: Hundreds of students , inspired in part by education al unrest in neighbouring France , have taken to the streets of the Belgian city of Liège, with local media reporting 107 arrests in recent days. Local authorities could not immediately be reached to confirm the arrests, which the Belga news agency reported were linked to offences including property damage and arson. Students have protested over Belgium's French-language education system, citing rising education costs , over crowded classrooms and difficulties accessing study materials. They held signs with slogans including "It's a mess, we are fighting for a right! Not a privilege!" and "I chose education , not the hunger games!!".

The unrest follows June clashes between protesters and police in Brussels over education reforms, including a tuition increase for most students in Belgium's French-speaking Community to €1,194 (US$1,280) from €835. Videos circulating on social media in recent days showed shattered glass, fires and hundreds of mostly young protesters in Liège, while other footage showed police blocking roads. During Wednesday's (Oct 7) protest, police were seen checking students for weapons.

A person throws an object into a burning structure on a street, on the day of a spontaneous street protest of high school students against education reforms introduced by the Wallonia-Brussels Federation government and an increase in student fees, in Liege, Belgium, Oct 7, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Stephanie Lecocq)

IN TOUCH WITH FRENCH STUDENTS Some students told Reuters they were in touch with French counterparts. "We support each other because we're facing pretty much the same issues," 19-year-old student Alfred said. Amelia Di Salve, also 19, who is studying to become a teacher, said Belgium's student movement began earlier this year and was reignited after students saw the demonstrations in France . "When we saw nothing was changing without protests , we decided we would start ... France did influence us a little," she said. Liège mayor Willy Demeyer told Belgian broadcaster RTBF he hoped calm would return and "that dialogue can be established and that the young people can express their grievances in a peaceful way and, if possible, have those concerns heard".

At least 24 killed in Ukraine, Zelenskiy condemns one of Russia’s most ‘vile strikes’

By Olena Harmash and Vladyslav Smilianets KYIV, Oct 7 (Reuters) – Russia pounded Ukraine with waves of missiles and drones in one of its most “vile strikes” on Wednesday, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said, killing at least 24 people, including children, and damaging industrial facilities and energy infrastructure.

The heaviest death toll was in Pryluky in Ukraine’s northern Chernihiv region, where a Russian missile obliterated a five-storey residential building. At least 18 people, including four children, were killed there, local officials said.

Zelenskiy said the strike coincided with Russian President Vladimir Putin’s birthday.

Show Full Article

“Today, as a birthday ‘gift’ to Putin, the Russian army destroyed a residential building in Pryluky…,” Zelenskiy said, adding that six more people were also killed in Kyiv, Oleksandria and Kremenchuk during the massive attack.

In total, Russia fired 70 missiles at Ukraine overnight – many of them high-velocity ballistic munitions – and dozens of Shahed attack drones, he said.

“The Russians wanted to strike painfully and demonstratively. This was one of the most vile strikes.”

In Pryluky, an excavator and dozens of rescuers with shovels sifted through rubble at the site where several sections of the apartment block had collapsed.

Emergency workers used ladders to get to the upper floors of what remained of the building, and brought out 15 people alive as they worked their way down through the rubble. Around 55 people were wounded in the town, regional officials said.

“There’s a lot of destruction, especially in the town centre,” said Danylo Savenko, deputy mayor of Pryluky, who said he had run to an air raid shelter with his wife as soon as he heard the missiles flying.

BIG JUMP IN REPORTED DRONE INTERCEPTIONS

Russia’s defence ministry said its forces had carried out a “massive strike” on military-industrial facilities in Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions, using high-precision land-, sea- and air-launched weapons, as well as drones.

Ukraine’s air force said it had downed just over 80% of the 46 jet-powered drones launched by Russia — a sharp increase from recent weeks when, on average, air defences took down 50% to 60%.

Since the summer, Russia has used increasing numbers of the new high-velocity drones in round-the-clock attacks on Kyiv and other cities, with Ukraine’s air defences struggling to cope with their speed.

The air force did not explain the jump in the interception rate and did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Zelenskiy said the Russian ballistic missiles remained the major challenge for Ukraine, adding that he and his team were “every day looking for Patriot (missile interception) systems that can and must protect people’s lives”.

Ukraine received a new €1.2 billion ($1.34 billion) tranche from the European Union on Wednesday and will channel the funds towards defence needs, Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said.

The US-made Patriot system is the only weapon in Ukraine’s arsenal capable of stopping high-velocity ballistic missiles but tight global supplies have been drained by the Iran war as well as the Ukraine conflict.

Russia’s defence ministry said its targets included sites where Ukrainian defence company Fire Point manufactures and stores its Flamingo cruise missiles and medium- and long-range drones in Kyiv as well as regions of Kyiv, Chernihiv, Kirovohrad, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava and Kharkiv.

Last week Zelenskiy said Ukraine had fired its first domestically made ballistic missile in combat, produced by Fire Point. In an interview with Reuters, he said he expected the company to have a longer-range FP-9 missile ready by the autumn. Fire Point has said that weapon will be able to reach Moscow.

PEOPLE SHELTER OVERNIGHT IN KYIV METRO

Zelenskiy said Ukrainian troops hit four targets in Russia over the past 24 hours, including two Russian oil facilities and a training ground in the Perm, Samara and Astrakhan regions.

In the Reuters interview, Zelenskiy said Ukraine would hit Russia’s energy assets in response to Moscow’s escalating strikes on civilian infrastructure.

Ukrainian officials and military intelligence shared warnings of the upcoming attacks on Wednesday, and many Kyiv residents took shelter in the city’s deep underground metro stations.

Several loud explosions reverberated through the capital during the night.

“The metro is better because we live on the 9th floor of a high-rise, and it’s really scary when you’re on the 9th floor and missiles are flying at you,” Lesia, a 49-year-old Kyiv resident, told Reuters.

Ukrainian officials said Russian ballistic missiles as well as the drones had targeted Kyiv.

Overnight air strikes on the southeastern city of Dnipro damaged an industrial facility, transport infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia and apartment buildings in Kremenchuk, regional officials said on the Telegram messaging app.

($1 = 0.8947 euros)

(Reporting by Olena Harmash in Kyiv and Vladislav Smilianets in Pryluky, additional reporting by Yuliia Dysa, Jekaterīna Golubkova; Editing by Daniel Flynn, Andrew Heavens and Gareth Jones)

item.title: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' about Tennessee's failed execution effort, lawyers say
item.description: Christa Pike, sentenced to death for a 1995 murder, awoke "angry and confused" in a hospital this week with a long recuperation ahead after surviving Tennessee's botched effort to execute her, her lawyers said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Allen
item.content:encoded: Christa Pike, sentenced to death for a 1995 murder, awoke "angry and confused" in a hospital this week with a long recuperation ahead after surviving Tennessee's botched effort to execute her, her lawyers said on Wednesday. A week ago, Pike, 50, was taken from the execution chamber to a Nashville hospital, unconscious, critically ill and with severe arm injuries after two injections of the caustic barbiturate pentobarbital [USN:L1N45N0VS TEXT:"failed to kill her"] at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution. As late as Monday, her lawyers believed Pike was brain dead and that life support would be removed the next day following the second botched execution in Tennessee this year, which has renewed scrutiny of capital punishment in the US . "But on Tuesday, to the shock of everyone, including me, including her team, and including the medical team, Christa woke up and began talking," Randall Spivey, one of her lawyers, told reporters after a court hearing on Wednesday, where a judge ordered Tennessee officials to preserve syringes and other evidence from the botched execution. "She is angry and confused about everything right now," Spivey said. "She is very aware that the state tried to execute her." Governor Bill Lee has suspended all executions for the rest of the year while investigators look into the botched executions of Pike and of Tony Carruthers in May, when prison officials were unable to set up intravenous lines. Pike remains very sick and shackled to her hospital bed, facing a long road to recovery, her lawyers said. She cannot swallow or eat, has pneumonia, cannot move her "tremendously swollen" hands or arms, and it is unclear if she will regain her lost mobility, they said. Although she still has "cognitive confusion," the lawyers said, she has been speaking with those around her. "She has wanted to know what's happened, and she's asked about several people," Spivey said. "She's asked about the victim's family." Pike was sentenced to death for her role as a teenager in the 1995 torture and murder of her 19-year-old schoolmate Colleen Slemmer. She is the first person known to have survived a "completed execution attempt" in the US, her lawyers say, calling it a violation of the Constitution's prohibition on cruel and unusual punishments. A UNIQUE CASE Pike's lawyers are unexpectedly continuing their litigation against state officials, seeking to pierce the secrecy that normally surrounds execution procedures in Tennessee and other states. Earlier on Wednesday, a judge in Davidson County Chancery Court, I'Ashea Myles, agreed to order Tennessee officials to preserve all evidence from the failed execution, including syringes, drug packaging and lot numbers, catheters, intravenous lines and gurney restraints. The all-female execution team requested by Pike used at least seven needles during a grueling ordeal that lasted more than two hours, and one needle was bent 90 degrees when it was pulled out, her lawyers said. Myles largely sided with Pike's lawyers at the end of Wednesday's hearing, describing the litigation, which began in January in an effort to prevent the scheduled execution, as unusual because no one had anticipated Pike surviving. "This case is unique, to say the least," Myles said. She also ordered the state to preserve internal communications about the attempted execution, including incident reports, witness accounts and encrypted messages. She has yet to rule on a request by Pike's lawyers that the Tennessee Department of Correction let them take any residual traces of the execution drugs for chemical analysis. The Tennessee Department of Correction has opposed what it says is a "duplicative and unnecessary" preservation order, arguing it is already legally required to preserve all evidence and that it was already willing to share most, if not all, of what Pike's lawyers sought. Tennessee and other US states have long struggled to acquire execution drugs. They cannot be obtained from major pharmaceutical companies because of a European trade ban on companies that sell products for use in torture or executions. Tennessee, like other states, has turned to small, largely unregulated compounding pharmacies to make small batches of the drugs, promising to hide their identity. "Today's hearing was about transparency, about why Christa, the courts, the media and the public should not simply take the state's word about what happened last Wednesday," Luke Ihnen, another lawyer for Pike, told reporters after the judge's ruling. He repeated the demand that Tennessee Governor Bill Lee commute Pike's sentence to life in prison and never attempt to execute her again. A spokesperson for Lee, who denied a clemency appeal two days before the failed execution, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Pike's lawyers had sought an alternative to lethal injections, saying her small veins and related medical conditions made her afraid that something would go wrong.

FAST

Oct 7 : Teens spend under 15 minutes a day on average on ChatGPT, while less than 2 per cent of them interact with the chatbot for over three straight hours, OpenAI said, as technology companies face scrutiny over the risks AI chatbots pose to children. Sam Altman's AI company released the figures in its first report on teen use on Wednesday as rapid adoption of AI platforms raises concerns about their impact on adolescent mental health and developmental safety. Such worries have been amplified by research on social media's harms to young users, with Meta in August agreeing to pay up to $18 billion and limit teens' use of Facebook and Instagram to settle claims that it designed the platforms to addict children. OpenAI said in nearly half of teen conversations where a break reminder appeared, the user either took a break or ended the chat within five minutes, aiming to show that its steps to regulate teen usage were working.

The company said users with access to its dedicated teen version sent more education-related messages and used tools like learning visualizations and Study Mode. It is now looking to add a college application planning tool that would help students with requirements, deadlines and financial-aid steps, as well as new study features such as flashcards and easier quiz-making tools. OpenAI began rolling out ChatGPT for Teens in August. The mode turns on automatically based on age information or when a user is estimated to be under 18, allowing parental controls and limiting conversations on sensitive topics. But a report by non-profit Common Sense Media on Wednesday said ChatGPT for Teens often alerted parents late or not at all when teen accounts held conversations about suicide, self-harm or eating disorders. The study, which is based on more than a dozen accounts created for testing, found the chatbot did not reliably suggest a crisis hotline or professional help. An OpenAI spokesperson said the testing does not "accurately reflect" how ChatGPT's teen safeguards work. Citing security and scale as reasons, the company said it may take hours for parent and teen accounts to link and for safety alerts to be active. "The bulk of their testing may have begun and concluded before activation of parental controls was complete," the spokesperson said. Common Sense Media said some of its test accounts were linked for long enough and some were not, but none of them produced timely alerts. Notifications only came through for accounts with weeks of sensitive-topic history, it said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 英30年債利回り、一時6.036％と28年ぶり高水準 世界的な債券売り
item.description:
David Milliken
[ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - ７日の英国債市場では、世界的な債券売りを受けて、３０...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英30年債利回り、一時6.036％と28年ぶり高水準　世界的な債券売り 0:50 配信

英国の５ポンド紙幣。2025年11月撮影。REUTERS/Phil Noble

David Milliken

[ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - ７日の英国債市場では、世界的な債券売りを受けて、３０年債利回りが一時２８年ぶりの高水準に上昇した。同国ではヒーリー財務相が３週間後に控える初の予算案発表に向けた圧力が一段と高まっている。

英３０年債利回りは１３４１ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後１０時４１分）に１３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇し６．０３６％と、１９９８年１月以来の高水準に達した。１日の上昇幅としては８月１４日以来の大きさとなる見通し。

英２０年債利回りも同様に過去最高水準に迫った。英１０年債利回りは１０ｂｐ上昇の５．４８％となった。

ヒーリー財務相は１０月２８日に初の予算案を発表する。バンク・オブ・アメリカのエコノミストは６日、ヒーリー財務相の予算案により、今会計年度および２０２７／２８年度にそれぞれ公的借り入れが１５０億ポンド（１９９億ドル）増加し、長期的な予算目標の達成に向けた余地が狭まるとの見方を示した。

item.description: ［リスボン ７日 ロイター］ - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのペレイラ・ポルトガル中銀総裁は７日、ユーロ圏...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏インフレ、波及効果見られず＝ポルトガル中銀総裁 0:44 配信

２０１８年４月撮影　REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

［リスボン　７日　ロイター］ - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのペレイラ・ポルトガル中銀総裁は７日、ユーロ圏の現在のインフレ率は、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻を起因とする２０２２年のエネルギー危機の際に見られた水準を大幅に下回っており、現時点で二次的な波及効果は見られないと述べた。

ペレイラ氏はリスボンでの記者会見で、その他のモノの価格に関しても足元でインフレ期待が不安定化している様子は見られないと指摘。２２年と現在のインフレの状況を比較すると、ユーロ圏とポルトガルのいずれにおいても「違いは顕著だ」とし、「総合インフレ率、コアインフレ率ともに現在は２２年を大幅に下回る水準にある」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：年初来安値で確認する円の「現在地」、円安は欧州通貨高の裏返し＝唐鎌大輔氏 アングル：欧州の中銀関係者、米国との協調維持に不安　市場介入に懸念 アングル：欧州の猛暑、経済損失は過去最大規模の恐れ　観光の変化で南欧に大打撃 アングル：欧州熱波、マクロ経済面からの市場注目ポイント アングル：欧州、熱波で気候変動への無防備さ露呈　「適応」対策が急務 最終更新: 10/8(木) 0:44 ロイター

item.title: 米1年先インフレ期待3.9％、23年5月以来の高水準＝ＮＹ連銀9月調査
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク ７日 ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク連銀が７日発表した９月の消費者調...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米1年先インフレ期待3.9％、23年5月以来の高水準＝ＮＹ連銀9月調査 0:28 配信

米ニューヨークの食料品店で８月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク　７日　ロイター] - 米ニューヨーク連銀が７日発表した９月の消費者調査によると、米国民の現在および将来の家計状況に対する見方が悪化する中、１年先のインフレ期待が３年超ぶりの高水準となった。

１年先のインフレ期待は３．９％と、前月の３．６％から上昇し、２０２３年５月以来の高水準となった。３年先のインフレ期待は３．３％と、前月の３．２％から上昇。５年先のインフレ期待は３．０％で横ばいだった。

ガソリン、食料品、家賃、医療費、大学費用など、同連銀が追跡する全カテゴリーについて、家計は将来的に値上がりすると予想した。

連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）当局者の多くは、足元のインフレ高止まりの主な要因として、トランプ大統領の関税措置の継続的な影響と中東での戦争に起因する原油価格の急騰、さらにテクノロジー分野における過熱した投資ペースによる圧力を挙げている。

一方、労働市場に対する見通しは若干改善し、１年後に失業率が上昇しているとの見方は前月から弱まった。また、非自発的に失業した場合に新たな職を見つけられる確率は高まった。

また、家計消費支出の伸び見通しは前月から上昇し、２３年５月以来の高水準となった。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か 最終更新: 10/8(木) 0:28 ロイター

item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 7 : The US Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday that it will vote on October 29 on whether to advance a new auction of wireless spectrum to boost "direct-to-device" services.The FCC told Reuters it will also hold an initial vote on modernizing its rules for "direct-to-device" s

US FCC to vote on advancing new spectrum auction to boost 'direct to device' services

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 7 : The US Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday that it will vote on October 29 on whether to advance a new auction of wireless spectrum to boost "direct-to-device" services. The FCC told Reuters it will also hold an initial vote on modernizing its rules for "direct-to-device" services and to finalize rules to allow drone operations within the 800 MHz cellular band.  Direct-to-device satellite technology allows smartphones and other devices to connect directly to satellites and is being developed by SpaceX, Amazon's Leo and others. The FCC in January said it was approving SpaceX's request to deploy another 7,500 second-generation Starlink satellites as it works to boost internet service worldwide, bringing the total to 15,000 satellites.

"The ‘direct-to-device’ proposals work to continue leveraging this cutting-edge tech to end cell phone dead zones and provide service directly from next-gen satellite constellations to your smartphone," FCC Chair Brendan Carr said in a statement. Carr said last month that a series of upcoming wireless spectrum auctions over the next couple of years could generate more than $100 billion in proceeds. The FCC is proposing to auction 25-megahertz of key spectrum for direct to device operations and make an additional 482 megahertz of spectrum available for supplemental coverage from space and consider other regulatory changes to promote more flexible terrestrial, satellite, and hybrid business arrangements for direct to device service.  SpaceX acquired 65 megahertz of wireless spectrum from EchoStar opens new tab for $19.6 billion through two deals announced last year, giving Starlink airwaves to expand into mobile services. The commission late Tuesday approved SpaceX's plan to use new spectrum it acquired to expand its direct to device plans. SpaceX's ambition to build a full-fledged mobile service rattled investors in the US wireless sector after the company in August outlined plans that could eventually pit Starlink against the three major US telecoms. Last week, AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon named wireless industry veteran Paul Roth as interim chief executive of their new joint venture aimed at expanding satellite-enabled mobile coverage. The FCC last week moved to release more spectrum to boost in-home satellite broadband.

Source: Reuters

item.description: La principales monedas de América Latina cerraron mixtas el miércoles, en una jornada de avance del dólar en los mercados globales, luego de que más temprano de los precios del crudo subieron y provocaron temores por la inflación, y tras la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de la Reserva Federal.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: La principales monedas de América Latina cerraron mixtas el miércoles, en una jornada de avance del dólar en los mercados globales, luego de que más temprano de los precios del crudo subieron y provocaron temores por la inflación, y tras la divulgación de las minutas de la última reunión de la Reserva Federal. * Las bolsas, en tanto, bajaron en línea con el descenso de Wall Street, que también comenzaba a girar su atención hacia los resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre. * El índice dólar , que mide el desempeño del billete verde frente a una canasta de seis monedas pares, trepó un 0,35%, y tras recortar brevemente sus ganancias, volvió a repuntar después de conocerse las minutas de la Fed. * Los responsables de la política monetaria de la Fed estuvieron divididos el mes pasado respecto de los motivos para subir las tasas de interés, mostraron el miércoles las minutas de la reunión de septiembre. * "Algunos participantes" consideraron que el alza era necesaria para contener el impacto de las perturbaciones de los precios de la energía y otros factores, mientras que un núcleo más "duro" la vio como imprescindible para protegerse de una inflación emergente impulsada por la demanda. * Pese a que datos económicos y algunos comentarios de autoridades de la Fed han reducido las expectativas de un incremento del costo del crédito a finales de octubre, los mercados descuentan un alza para diciembre. * Los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro, en tanto, revirtieron sus avances por la tarde, tras alcanzar nuevos máximos en décadas, ante el descenso de los precios del petróleo y una sólida subasta de notas a 10 años. * El crudo cambió de tendencia y cayó el miércoles, después de que la Agencia Internacional de la Energía acordara acelerar la liberación de reservas y dar prioridad al diésel. * El peso mexicano bajaba hacia el cierre un ligero 0,05%, a 17,9855 unidades por dólar, luego de tres sesiones de alzas; mientras que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, descendió un 1,04%, a 64.632,80 puntos, también después de tres avances consecutivos. * "Hacia el 'overnight', prevemos un rango entre $17,89 y $18,10, ante la moderación del dólar estadounidense a mitad de jornada, a la espera de la publicación de las cifras de inflación de septiembre y de las minutas de Banxico el día de mañana", dijo Monex en un reporte. * El real brasileño cayó un 0,83%, a 5,0156 unidades por dólar la venta, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) retrocedió preliminarmente un 0,72%, a 204.348 puntos, en una jornada de ajustes tras las fuertes alzas del lunes luego del resultado de la primera ronda de las elecciones presidenciales del domingo, donde Flávio Bolsonaro superó a Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. * El peso chileno , cerró la jornada con una baja del 0,63%, a 978,20/978,50 unidades por dólar, presionado por el avance global del billete verde. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) retrocedió un 1,47%, a 10.999,64 puntos. * El peso colombiano cedió parte de sus alzas de más temprano y cerró con una leve alza de un 0,08% a 3.239 unidades por dólar; mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el COLCAP (.COLCAP) , terminó con caída de un 2,09% a 2.534,9 puntos. * Los agentes locales permanecían a la expectativa del dato de inflación de septiembre, que apuntaba a un aumento, elevando las expectativas del mercado de un nuevo incremento en la tasa de interés este mes. * El peso mayorista argentino cambió de tendencia y se apreció un 0,13%, a 1.518 por cada dólar, con el banco central (BCRA) regulando la liquidez e interviniendo en la plaza de contratos de futuros para frenar bruscas fluctuaciones intradiarias. * El BCRA compró 45 millones de dólares y suma algo más de 14.700 millones de dólares adquiridos, contra los 10.000 millones comprometidos en un acuerdo vigente con el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI). * Mientras, el índice accionario líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires retrocedió un 2,51% al cierre, luego de acumular un alza del 3,7% en los dos primeros días de la semana. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se depreció un 0,29%, a 3,4440/3,4450 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdió un 1,31%, a 1.571,13 puntos.

item.title: ＩＥＡ、備蓄放出加速で1億バレル供給へ ディーゼル優先
item.description:
Kate Abnett Holger Hansen
[ブリュッセル／パリ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kate Abnett　Holger Hansen

[ブリュッセル／パリ　７日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）は７日、中東情勢を背景にした燃料価格の高騰と供給混乱に対応するため、３月に開始した戦略石油備蓄放出を加速させるとともに、ディーゼル（軽油）の備蓄放出を優先する方針で合意した。

ＩＥＡは３月、過去最大規模となる４億バレルの備蓄放出を開始したが、このうち約１億バレルが市場にまだ供給されていない。ＩＥＡはこの日、備蓄放出を可能な限り迅速に進めることで、この約１億バレルが市場に届くとの見通しを示した。ディーゼルを優先するとしたものの、ディーゼルと原油の内訳は明らかにしていない。

主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向けＩＥＡを通じてディーゼルなどの備蓄１億バレルを協調放出するとする首脳共同声明を発表。Ｇ７はトランプ米大統領がディーゼルを多く市場に供給しなければ米国からの軽油輸出を禁止する可能性があると警告したことを受け、協調放出方針を発表した。

ＩＥＡのこの日の表明はＧ７の協調放出の発表を受けたもので、ＩＥＡのビロル事務局長は声明で「ＩＥＡ加盟国は３月の共同対応で発表した備蓄放出を加速させ、可能な限り早期に完了させることを支持した。現在のディーゼル市場の逼迫状況を踏まえ、可能な範囲でディーゼル備蓄の放出を優先することも支持した」とした。

ＩＥＡは来週に開かれる理事会で今回示した方針について検証する。

ＩＥＡの発表を受け、欧州連合（ＥＵ）加盟国は今後の備蓄放出は３月に承認された数量の範囲内で実施されるべきとの認識で一致。また、フランスは戦略備蓄から１０００万バレルのディーゼルを放出すると発表した。

item.content:encoded:

Conservative anti-tax group seeks FCC approval for AI robocalls ahead of US midterms

FILE PHOTO: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) seal decorates a wall inside their headquarters in Washington, D.C., U.S., July 22, 2026. REUTERS/Kylie Cooper/File Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 7 : A Democratic member of the Federal Communications Commission urged the agency on Wednesday not to approve a petition to allow political AI-generated robocalls from conservative political group Club for Growth. The group, which is spending millions of dollars ahead of the November US congressional elections, asked the FCC to allow it to make political calls to cell phones "using an artificial or prerecorded voice - including an AI-generated voice - without obtaining prior express consent." FCC Commissioner Anna Gomez said that if "the FCC allows a dark money group to flood Americans' phones with AI-generated robocalls they never agreed to receive, it would bring chaos so close to Election Day."  She added that "consumers reasonably expect the rules protecting them from unwanted robocalls to hold steady while they decide how to vote, not for the FCC to change them at the 11th hour to unleash a deluge of political AI slop on their phones."

Club for Growth President David McIntosh said in a statement that the group wants "the FCC to treat First Amendment-protected political speech the same way it already treats wireless calls about package deliveries, bank accounts, and doctor's appointments." The group, which backs conservative economic views on taxes, regulations and cutting the size of government, plans to spend $175 million in the midterm congressional elections, it said on its website. The group argued it is incorrect to refer to the calls as robocalls because a human initiates the dial to a cell phone and then an AI agent handles an interview. The FCC, in describing the petition, said the system "uses a perfunctory human being for the sole purpose of clicking on a ‘send’ or similarly termed button to transmit thousands of text messages per hour." A number of public interest groups on Monday urged the FCC not to grant the petition. "Using robocalls, a hated form of communication, to deliver political messages, a sensitive topic almost nobody wants to hear about from AI-generated strangers, will enrage a wide swath of the 98 per cent of the country that has a cellphone," said the comment signed by groups including the Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights, Consumer Federation of America, Common Cause and Public Citizen. The FCC is considering comments on the petition until October 19. A spokesman for FCC Chair Brendan Carr declined immediate comment.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Spanish unions call general strike for November 11, weeks before snap election
item.description: Trade unions in Spain on Wednesday announced a nationwide general strike over housing issues for November 11, a protest that will take place a few weeks before a snap election in which rising rents and evictions have become campaign topics.
item.dc:creator: Mireia Merino, David Latona
item.content:encoded: Trade unions in Spain on Wednesday announced a nationwide general strike over housing issues for November 11, a protest that will take place a few weeks before a [USN:L8N45R0GH TEXT:"snap election"] in which rising rents and evictions [USN:L8N45Q06Q TEXT:"have become campaign topics"]. The country's two largest unions, UGT and CCOO, said they had agreed on the date, although it still needs to be formally ratified by other unions in a meeting later on Wednesday. It will be the first general strike jointly backed by Spain's two largest unions in 14 years. The strike will be the latest in a series of demonstrations provoked by the [USN:L8N45F0PQ TEXT:"eviction of an 87-year-old woman"] in Madrid, with activists camping on one of the capital's main squares calling for solutions to a mounting housing crisis. Those protests, along with [USN:L1N45O0BD TEXT:"parliament's rejection last week"] of decrees aimed at curbing evictions and limiting rent pressures, prompted Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez to call an [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"early election"] for November 29. Sanchez is seeking to shift the political narrative from his government's [USN:L1N4510WI TEXT:"handling of a migrant crisis"] in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta and a [USN:L1N42U0KB TEXT:"series of corruption cases"] involving his Socialist Party and his family to the housing crisis, an area in which he believes he can harness growing resentment about rising rents. Spain has a deficit of about 750,000 homes, which is set to grow to more than a million by 2028, according to the Bank of Spain. With fewer people able to afford a home, renting has increased sharply, putting pressure on that market. The average rental price of €1,176 ($1,315) is equivalent to about 98.7% of a young person's average monthly salary in Spain, according to the Youth Council of Spain. "We cannot ignore the fact that housing is where most of our wages go. What is the point of raising the minimum wage if housing costs are rising three, four or five times faster?" said Tenants' Union spokesperson Valeria Racu. ($1 = 0.8946 euros)

item.title: 仏経済は堅調、国債利回り上昇の波及見られず＝ユーロ圏高官
item.description: ［ブリュッセル ７日 ロイター］ - ユーロ圏の高官は７日、フランス経済は非常に堅調でいかなる課題にも対応する能力が...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏経済は堅調、国債利回り上昇の波及見られず＝ユーロ圏高官 0:00 配信

２０１６年３月撮影　REUTERS/Benoit Tessier

［ブリュッセル　７日　ロイター］ - ユーロ圏の高官は７日、フランス経済は非常に堅調でいかなる課題にも対応する能力があるとの見解を示し、国債利回り上昇の影響が他のユーロ圏の経済に広がる兆候は今のところ見られていないと述べた。

ユーロ圏財務相会議の準備に携わる高官は「これまで目にしているのはニュースに反応したフランス国債利回りの動きであり、その反応はおおむね理解できる」と語った。

フランスの金融システムは「非常に堅固だ」と指摘し、「政治的に複雑な状況にあるものの、問題解決の選択肢はあり、特に心配はしていない」と述べた。その上で、「責任ある予算を毎年成立させることができる均衡点を見いだす必要がある。それぞれの政治勢力が駆け引きを止め、経済に対する責任に真摯に向き合う必要がある」と強調した。

item.title: ホルムズ海峡のタンカー攻撃 、週間12件とイラン開戦以降最多＝海事筋
item.description:
Jonathan Saul
[ロンドン ７日 ロイター] - 湾岸諸国の産油国による輸出拡大が進む中、ホルムズ海峡を通過するタンカーへの攻撃が先週、週単位ではイラン戦争開始以降で最多となった。海事安全保障筋が明らかにした。
３人の安全保障筋が同地域から得た情報を基に分析したデータによると、９月２８日─１０月５日までの１週間に、ホルムズ海峡周辺で原油タンカーや液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）、液化石油ガス（ＬＰＧ）のタンカーに対する攻撃は少なくとも１２件発生した。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jonathan Saul

[ロンドン　７日　ロイター] - 湾岸諸国の産油国による輸出拡大が進む中、ホルムズ海峡を通過するタンカーへの攻撃が先週、週単位ではイラン戦争開始以降で最多となった。海事安全保障筋が明らかにした。

３人の安全保障筋が同地域から得た情報を基に分析したデータによると、９月２８日─１０月５日までの１週間に、ホルムズ海峡周辺で原油タンカーや液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）、液化石油ガス（ＬＰＧ）のタンカーに対する攻撃は少なくとも１２件発生した。 関係筋によると、これは２月２８日に米国とイランの戦争が始まって以来、１週間あたりの攻撃件数としては最多となる。

米国主導による多国籍の共同海事情報センター（ＪＭＩＣ）は４日付の報告書で、同海峡では、イランの「革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）」による攻撃や攻撃未遂のほか、ドローン（無人機）の上空通過、監視活動、ＶＨＦ無線による呼びかけなどの嫌がらせ行為が続いていると説明。「こうした行動は、主要な輸送路沿いで存在感を示し、通航する船舶への圧力を維持しようとするイランの意図を引き続き示している」と指摘した。

国連の国際海事機関（ＩＭＯ）がまとめた別のデータによると、同週に船舶が関与した事案は９件だった。海事関係筋は、ＩＭＯは事案の確認や公式記録に時間がかかる傾向があると指摘した。

ＩＭＯの別のデータによると、件数で比較可能な直近の週は７月１３日の週で、発生した事案は８件だった。

item.title: イエメン避難民20万人超、フーシ派と政府軍の戦闘激化で＝ＩＯＭ
item.description:
Olivia Le Poidevin
[ジュネーブ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olivia Le Poidevin

[ジュネーブ ７日 ロイター] - 国連の国際移住機関（ＩＯＭ）のデータによると、ここ数週間で激化しているイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派と、サウジアラビアが支援するイエメン暫定政府軍との戦闘を受け、イエメン国内では７日時点で２０万人以上が避難を余儀なくされたことが分かった。

避難民数は９月中旬の約７万６０００人から急増しており、ＩＯＭは憂慮すべき状況との見方を示している。

item.title: Denmark says Russia has conducted sabotage attacks against its defense firms
item.description: Russia has begun sabotage operations against Danish companies supplying Ukraine after concluding that broader disruption efforts failed to curb Western military support for the country, a Danish intelligence official said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
item.content:encoded: Russia has begun sabotage operations against Danish companies supplying Ukraine after concluding that broader disruption efforts failed to curb Western military support for the country, a Danish intelligence official said on Wednesday. The shift reflects a significant escalation in Moscow's [USN:L8N45F1L2 TEXT:"hybrid warfare"] campaign, the official, from the Danish national security and intelligence service (PET), told a homeland security conference in Copenhagen. "What we saw in the spring was a lot of planning, but very little carried out; what we saw in early summer is that they started to carry out a lot more," the official said. Russia concluded that its previous broad-spectrum targeting "did not have the effect of deterring the Western (military alliance) NATO from supporting Ukraine," the official added, and while Moscow maintains political control over operations, its operational boldness is growing and Russia is now "trying to hit targets that have a direct impact on the front line. That means weapons production." Moscow has repeatedly denied involvement in sabotage or hybrid warfare operations. The Russian embassy in Copenhagen rejected the allegations on Wednesday, accusing Danish authorities of making unfounded accusations against Russia. The official cited a [USN:L1N40Y0RY TEXT:"Russian defence ministry list"] of alleged European drone and drone component manufacturers that Moscow said in April amounted to potential military targets, without elaborating further. Russia is increasingly using [USN:L1N44V0FB TEXT:"untrained proxies"] — including homeless people and people addicted to drugs — recruited via Telegram and other social media platforms. Recruitment typically starts with low-threshold tasks such as reconnaissance or photography, then escalates toward actual sabotage operations, PET has said. "It could be anyone just looking for quick money," the official said. "If the first person isn't successful, they'll throw another one at the problem until they succeed." Denmark's defence intelligence service last month said Russia is likely to [USN:L8N45G0M0 TEXT:"intensify hybrid attacks"] against the West in coming months, after Germany blamed Russia for an attempted drone attack at [USN:L8N44T1P2 TEXT:"Leipzig/Halle Airport"] in August. In September 2025, before Denmark hosted an EU summit, [USN:L5N3VG0CN TEXT:"drones disrupted air traffic"] at six Danish airports, including Copenhagen, the Nordic region's busiest, in what Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen called a hybrid attack on her nation.

item.title: Webull sinks after US House panel report flags China ties
item.description: Shares of Webull dropped to a near-four-month low on Wednesday after a US congressional panel said the online trading platform was "tied in structural ways" to the Chinese government, prompting a strong rebuke from the company.
item.dc:creator: Jayasree Prabhu
item.content:encoded: Shares of Webull (BULL.O) dropped to a near-four-month low on Wednesday after a US congressional panel said the online trading platform was "tied in structural ways" to the Chinese government, prompting a strong rebuke from the company. The bipartisan House Select Committee on China said in a report released on Wednesday that it found "a profound gap" between the company's public marketing and actual control, sending Webull's shares plummeting 19.1%. The findings underscore growing scrutiny of Chinese links to companies operating in key areas of the US economy, including financial services. "Webull has made every effort to cooperate with the Committee, but did not hear from them for more than 20 months before this report was released," a company spokesperson said. "It is deeply disappointing that the Select Committee published a report containing significant inaccuracies and unsupported conclusions without ever seeking clarification from Webull," the spokesperson added, noting that the company stores US customer data in the US. CNBC first reported the details of the congressional panel's report earlier on Wednesday. "Using technology providers in mainland China and an opaque China-linked ownership structure, Webull exposes its data to our foremost adversary. Investors should heed this information when choosing who they do business with," said John Moolenaar, who is leading the committee with Ro Khanna. Analysts at Scotiabank said the near-term question is whether the findings prompt executive agencies or financial regulators to initiate or broaden their own reviews. "For now, the report will weigh on valuation rather than actual financial results," the brokerage said. A TENSE RELATIONSHIP While the US and China have been under a tariff truce for about a year, tensions remain. Last week, Congressman Ro Khanna, a Democrat, warned that [USN:L1N45M17H TEXT:"Beijing could steal"] AI model weights developed by OpenAI, Anthropic and other top US firms, erasing the US edge over China. "I want to emphasize that protectionism does not make the US more competitive. China firmly opposes the US overstretching the concept of national security," a spokesperson for the Chinese embassy in the US said in an emailed statement to Reuters. Chinese President Xi Jinping has also described the relationship between the two superpowers through the "Thucydides Trap," a theory that competition between a rising power and an established one tends to lead to war. US President Donald Trump's lavish three-day summit last month for President Xi [USN:L1N45G0E0 TEXT:"delivered no breakthroughs"] on thorny issues such as AI, trade, Taiwan and the war with Iran. "The potential regulatory and operational implications of these findings create a level of uncertainty that we cannot reasonably incorporate into our estimates," Siebert Financial analyst Brian Vieten said, while suspending his buy rating and price target on Webull's stock.

item.title: 米政府とグーグル、メタＣＥＯのバイオハブに参画 生物学ＡＩに18億ドル投資へ
item.description:
Krystal Hu
[７日 ロイター] - 米政府と米メタ・プラットフォームズ、グーグル親会社のアルファベットが、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米政府とグーグル、メタＣＥＯのバイオハブに参画　生物学ＡＩに18億ドル投資へ 10/7 23:26 配信

米メタのマーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と妻のプリシラ・チャン氏。2025年4月、カリフォルニア州サンタモニカで撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni

Krystal Hu

[７日　ロイター] - 米政府と米メタ・プラットフォームズ、グーグル親会社のアルファベットが、非営利研究機関「バイオハブ」に参画し、生物学研究用の人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルの学習に向けたオープンデータセットの構築に乗り出す。この取り組みへの投資総額は１８億ドルに達する見通し。バイオハブが７日に明らかにした。

「バイオハブ」にはメタ、グーグル傘下グーグル・ディープマインド、創薬スタートアップのアイソモルフィックラボが共同で３億ドルを投じる。米エネルギー省は実験室での測定、モデリング、計算に今後５年間で５億ドル超を拠出する。また、米国立衛生研究所（ＮＩＨ）は、５億ドル超の連邦資金でこれまでに構築されたデータセットとリポジトリを調整し、バイオハブがこれらをＡＩの訓練用に標準化する。

バイオハブはメタのマーク・ザッカーバーグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と妻のプリシラ・チャン氏による慈善事業として運営されている。

モデル訓練向けの生物学データの獲得を巡っては、アンソロピックやオープンＡＩも同様の取り組みを進めている。アンソロピックはＡＩ技術を応用した医薬品開発の本格化に向け、生物学の研究を行うための実験施設（ウェットラボ）を開設した。オープンＡＩ財団はＡＩ研究向けの生物・医療データセット構築のため、１億２５００万ドル超の助成プログラムを開始した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：空前のＡＩ投資、相応の経済効果実現へなお高いハードル アングル：ＡＩ競争でグーグル躍進、ウォール街も設備投資急増への評価一変 コラム：グーグル、ＡＩブームの賭けで存在感 アングル：ウクライナ、グーグルと独自ＡＩシステム開発　決め手は多言語対応 アングル：ＡＩハードウエア競争、グーグル「手本はエヌビディア」 最終更新: 10/7(水) 23:26 ロイター

item.title: イラン高官、米の核開発巡る「考え」相いれず 核濃縮はレッドライン
item.description: [ドバイ ７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ ７日 ロイター] - イラン当局者は７日、同国の核開発計画に関する米国の「要求や構想」はイラン側の要求と相いれないとの認識を示した。

バンス米副大統領が、イランは米国の要求を満たし７カ月に及ぶ戦争を終結させるためには、ウラン濃縮能力を「意味のある形で」削減する必要があるとの考えを示したことについて、当局者はロイターに対し、「バンス氏の発言は米政権の考えや要求を反映したものだ。米国側には要求を示し、自らの考えを持つ自由があるが、その内容はイランの要求とは相いれない」と語った。

さらに、イランの核開発計画を巡り、米国との交渉は一切行われておらず、核協議を開始するには米国がイラン側の条件を満たす必要があると述べた。また、核濃縮に関する条件はイランにとっての「レッドライン（越えられない一線）」であり、「この点についてはいかなる形でも柔軟性を示すことはない」とした。ただ、濃縮の詳細を巡り後日協議することは可能との認識も示した。

item.description: Oct 7 : After suffering a major legislative defeat at the hands of Senate Democrats last month, the crypto industry is grappling with a dilemma three weeks out from the November election: punish Democrats, or preserve the bipartisan ties it has spent years building. During the current and previous election cy

Analysis:Crypto donors navigate mid-term spending dilemma after Senate bill defeat

FAST

Oct 7 : After suffering a major legislative defeat at the hands of Senate Democrats last month, the crypto industry is grappling with a dilemma three weeks out from the November election: punish Democrats, or preserve the bipartisan ties it has spent years building. During the current and previous election cycles, the industry has spent more than $300 million backing crypto-friendly Democrats and Republicans in roughly equal measure, hoping to pass legislation US crypto companies say will put them on a solid legal footing and allow them to thrive. That strategy paid off with last year's new law promoting dollar-backed cryptocurrencies, but suffered a major blow last month when all Senate Democrats and a handful of Republicans voted against advancing the Clarity Act, which the industry says would have provided the legal clarity it has long lobbied for. US President Donald Trump's personal crypto ventures became a flashpoint in the bill negotiations, prompting Democrats to push for tougher restrictions on officeholders' crypto dealings. Their decision to vote against the bill despite winning many concessions angered crypto executives, while the broader fight has made crypto more of a partisan issue, said analysts.

Nine Democrats are up for reelection in the Senate, including some the industry had viewed as allies. With polls showing the party has a slight edge, the crypto industry is weighing whether to continue with its bipartisan strategy in the Senate, or to reward Republicans, who overwhelmingly supported Clarity, said four executives involved in the discussions. While it's unlikely a Democratic-led Senate will pass crypto legislation, turning the midterms into a referendum on Clarity could squander years of relationship-building and alienate lawmakers who may be in power next year, some executives warn. “It's a pretty hard needle to thread," said Ron Hammond, head of policy and advocacy at crypto trading firm Wintermute, adding that the big crypto spenders have been "navigating this very carefully." CRYPTO HAS PUNISHED ADVERSARIES BEFORE Fairshake, a crypto super PAC backed by Coinbase and Ripple among others, started the year with $193 million. On Monday, it said it would back 32 House candidates spanning both parties, but has not announced a Senate strategy. It has spent on 57 races this cycle, winning many. “Fairshake has always been and always will be an issue-focused organization. We back pro-crypto candidates who support American innovation in both parties," said spokesperson Geoff Vetter. Crypto PACs have previously targeted vulnerable adversaries. In 2024, Fairshake spent about $40 million successfully unseating former incumbent Ohio Senate Democrat Sherrod Brown, who criticized the industry's Washington influence. In a sign of what may come, the PAC is spending $30 million opposing his bid to return to the Senate. Digital Freedom Fund, a super PAC backed by crypto entrepreneurs Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, is also spending $3 million opposing Brown and supporting current Ohio Republican Senator Jon Husted, who voted for Clarity, federal filings show. It's also spending $400,000 in the race for Iowa's open Senate seat, splitting the cash between backing pro-crypto Republican Ashley Hinson and opposing her Democratic rival. Spokespeople for the Winklevoss twins and Hinson did not respond to requests for comment. Ripple declined to comment. A spokesperson for Brown's campaign accused Husted of being "for sale." A Husted campaign spokesperson said Brown was "terrified of having his abysmal record splashed across TV screens." Until recently, the industry's aggressive spending made candidates think twice about crossing it, analysts say, but executives worry it's a risky strategy, especially against incumbents. Many believe crypto can still be a bipartisan issue and that the industry should find ways to settle scores without jeopardizing those ties. Among those up for reelection, for example, are New Jersey's Cory Booker and Virginia's Mark Warner, both senior Democratic lawmakers whom the industry sees as key allies. They broadly supported crypto legislation but ultimately opposed Clarity, citing insufficient curbs on officeholder crypto dealings. Warner and Booker sit on the Senate Banking and Agriculture committees respectively, which jointly drafted the bill. With both senators in relatively safe races, attacking them could backfire, executives said. Spokespeople for the senators' campaigns did not respond to requests for comment. Senate control would also hand Democrats committee oversight powers which they plan to use to probe crypto companies with ties to Trump. In what analysts said was a potentially ironic twist, there is a chance that Brown, whom recent polls put slightly ahead of Husted, could reprise his leadership of the Banking Committee if he wins. One of the crypto executives who wished to remain anonymous said attacking Democrats "didn't do us a lot of good," and others expect the industry will ultimately focus on rewarding friends in either party. "I do think you're going to see the industry lick its wounds and get back aggressively to supporting the pro-Clarity type folks," said Josh Riezman, chief legal and strategy officer at crypto firm GSR. Stand With Crypto, a nonprofit backed by Coinbase, has endorsed dozens of candidates and is spending on advertising in some races. Its executive director Mason Lynaugh last month warned that the Clarity vote had exposed which officials were "against" the industry. But most of its latest endorsements are for House or Senate lawmakers who voted for Clarity on both sides of the aisle. “We have the potential to move the outcomes or at least play a significant factor in helping reelect these crypto champions," said Lynaugh.

Source: Reuters
